13507.description_html:
Distributed Systems Engineer (High-Throughput Ledger & Sync)

About Us & Our Mission :

Our company builds mission-critical B2B SaaS architecture operating at the demanding intersection of global supply chain logistics and high-throughput fintech settlement rails. Our platform ingests millions of inventory telemetry events, transactional ledger movements, and vector search queries every single hour. Maintaining absolute data consistency, partition tolerance, and low latency across distributed nodes is the core engineering challenge that keeps our platform running smoothly.

We believe that building resilient distributed systems requires deep architectural discipline, rigorous concurrency control, and clean, modular code. If you are passionate about solving hard problems in distributed consistency, event sourcing, and high-concurrency database states, you will find your ultimate engineering home with us.

The Role & Impact :

We are seeking an elite, hands-on Distributed Systems Engineer to take full ownership of our core ledger synchronization and transactional state replication engine. In this role, you will design, build, and scale distributed backend services that guarantee ACID compliance and high availability across multi-region cloud deployments. You won't just write standard CRUD endpoints; you will architect fault-tolerant consensus mechanisms, optimize network partition recovery, and ensure that our financial ledgers and supply chain telemetry remain perfectly synchronized under massive enterprise load.

Key Responsibilities :

- Distributed Architecture : Design, build, and scale low-latency distributed microservices and consensus-driven backend architectures using Go, Rust, or Python.

- State Synchronization : Implement event-sourcing patterns, CQRS, and distributed locking mechanisms to handle high-concurrency transactional updates.

- Database Partitioning & Sharding : Architect and manage horizontal database sharding, cross-region replication, and eventual-consistency models for large-scale enterprise data stores.

- Resiliency & Fault Tolerance : Build robust retry logic, circuit breakers, dead-letter queues, and automated failover systems to handle network partitions and service degradation gracefully.

- Performance Profiling : Conduct deep bottleneck analysis, memory profiling, and network payload optimization to achieve sub-millisecond internal response times.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner closely with data engineering, DevOps, and product squads to align distributed system capabilities with evolving business requirements.

What We Are Looking For :

- Experience : 3 to 6 years of professional backend software engineering experience focusing heavily on distributed systems, concurrency, and high-throughput data processing.

- Technical Mastery : Deep proficiency in systems programming or backend engineering using Go, Rust, or Python, combined with advanced understanding of networking protocols (TCP/UDP, gRPC, HTTP/2).

- Database & Messaging Expertise : Hands-on experience with distributed databases (CockroachDB, Cassandra, or distributed PostgreSQL setups) and event streaming brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ).

- Theoretical Foundation : Solid grasp of the CAP theorem, consensus algorithms (Raft/Paxos), distributed transactions (2PC/Saga patterns), and vector clock synchronization.

- Engineering Mindset : Strong system design capabilities, meticulous debugging skills, and a proactive ownership mentality.

What We Offer :

- Competitive Compensation : Industry-leading salary package (22 - 38 LPA) structured with base pay, performance bonuses, and meaningful equity participation.

- Cutting-Edge Tech Stack : Total freedom to work with modern distributed computing primitives and high-scale enterprise architecture.

- Growth & Wellness : Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents, plus an annual learning stipend for tech conferences and advanced training.

13287.description_html:
We're looking for Junior and Senior Developers to join our fully remote team. If you like complexity and want your work to actually matter, you'll fit right in.

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. Our mission is to automate everything a property manager does.

What you'll do

You'll build with Claude and Cursor. What exactly you work on depends on where you land — our work splits roughly like this:

  • Product (Full-Stack). Work on the software property managers use all day. Help us improve what's there and push our roadmap forward by owning new features and refining them until they're as easy to use as the Uber app.

  • Integrations (Backend). Handle every way data gets into our platform. Email, phone calls (Twilio & Vonage), WhatsApp. The other half is moving customers off whatever they used before: Importing years of email, hundreds of thousands of documents, and every record on their buildings, apartments, contracts and contacts, plus syncing with systems a customer still runs alongside us.

  • Agents (Backend). Improve the agent platform behind with 200+ tools and a built-in knowledge base. Customers build and train their own agents in a sandbox or use agents we've already built for them. Both text and voice.

Our minimalistic tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $1000 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

You are:

  • fluent in English.

  • a seasoned developer with more than a year of experience shipping production code

  • a builder first. You'd rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.

  • comfortable working autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks.

  • writing almost al of your code with AI.

  • performing even better when working under performance pressure.

  • quick to learn new things and consider yourself a generalist, not a specialist.

Your techstack:

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

Nice to have:

  • Solid backend and systems-design experience – experience designing a database from the ground up (tables, relationships, indexes) and also with optimizing query performance & cost

  • Experience building production agents

  • Comfort with queues and long-running workflows

13607.description_html:
What We Do

 

At GoGuardian, we’re helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world’s greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe. 

 

What It’s Like to Work at GoGuardian

We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why “I love the people here” is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II, Fullstack to design and implement solid architectural solutions with the rest of the engineering team, supporting our Pear Assessment product - a platform that provides real-time, interactive formative assessments, enabling teachers to capture diverse student responses, gain instant insights, and adapt instruction across live and self-paced learning environments.

With a passion for solving problems quickly and delivering high-quality code, you will build features that enable real-time formative assessments and actionable learning insights for educators. You’ll work across the full stack—from crafting intuitive React-based classroom experiences and interactive assessment workflows to designing scalable backend services and optimizing data pipelines that power instant feedback and analytics. You will also contribute to OpenSearch-powered semantic search capabilities, enabling fast and relevant discovery across more than 500 million educational documents. Our Engineering team thrives on a purpose-driven culture of collaboration, openness, trust, and transparency, with individuals who continuously push boundaries to improve teaching and learning outcomes.

_________________________________________________________________________________________

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and continually improve our Pear Assessment product and related services
  • Build and ship features that power real-time formative assessments and classroom engagement experiences for educators and students.
  • Develop & maintain high-performance backend services in Typescript that power the assessment platform
  • Develop intuitive, high-performance React interfaces for interactive assessments, dashboards, and data visualization
  • Develop and enhance OpenSearch-based semantic search systems to enable fast, relevant discovery across hundreds of millions of educational documents
  • Optimize data pipelines and queries to deliver low-latency insights and feedback to teachers during live and asynchronous sessions
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and data teams to translate educational needs into impactful technical solutions.
  • Ensure system reliability, scalability, and performance under high usage across classrooms and districts.
  • Continuously improve code quality, testing practices, and engineering standards within a collaborative team environment.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Architect and operate cloud-native systems on AWS, leveraging services like SQS for asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows.
  • Work with MongoDB and other data stores to model, store, and efficiently query large-scale assessment and engagement data.
  • Integrate AWS IoT services where applicable to support real-time classroom device interactions and data ingestion.
  • Integrate LLM/AI services to power intelligent features such as automated insights, content generation, and enhanced search relevance.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of professional industry experience building and delivering scalable software features in a production environment
  • Strong experience with Javascript/Typescript/Nodejs/Python and familiarity with concurrency patterns, APIs, and service-oriented architecture
  • Experience building modern React applications with TypeScript, including working with APIs, state management, and responsive UI components
  • Familiarity with designing and consuming APIs (REST/WSS) and contributing to backend services handling moderate to high traffic
  • Working knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL such as MongoDB/PostgreSQL), including basic query optimization and data modeling
  • Understanding of caching concepts (e.g., Redis) and performance optimization techniques
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and services like S3, SQS, or similar
  • Experience with modern frontend tooling and libraries (e.g., React Query, component libraries)
  • Ability to build reliable, maintainable, and scalable features with guidance from senior engineers
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on code quality, testing, and continuous improvement
  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a willingness to learn and grow
  • Motivated by the opportunity to build impactful products in the education space

Nice to Have

  • Experience with big data analytics tools (AWS Athena, Spark, or similar query engines)
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, or similar)
  • Experience with message queues and event-driven architectures (SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Prior experience in EdTech or building products for K-12 education
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and basic orchestration concepts
  • Exposure to data processing or aggregation workflows for generating insights from application data
  • Something else? Tell us! We want to learn more about you…

 What We Offer 

  • Competitive pay, health insurance, accident insurance, life insurance, and a retirement savings plan.
  • Paid annual leave, paid holidays, paid parental leave, paid leave for life events, and a paid year-end holiday break.
  • A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, wellness checks, and more…

Plus the intangible:

  • A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
  • Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.


Please share this with your friends or co-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talented people. 

 

GoGuardian is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. GoGuardian does not discriminate against employees, applicants, interns or volunteers on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, sex, age, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

 

GoGuardian's Job Applicant Privacy Policy is located here.

What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What's the position?

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Quantitative Sports team. We’re building the next generation of our in‑house pricing engine — a low‑latency, high‑throughput system that powers live odds for millions of users. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll own major architectural decisions, partner directly with quantitative analysts, and shape the core backend that drives our sportsbook.

This is a high‑impact role with significant autonomy. If you thrive in fast‑moving environments and love solving complex real‑time engineering challenges, you’ll feel at home here.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and build backend services that operate reliably under intense data and user load

  • Reduce system latency and optimize real‑time performance across the pricing pipeline

  • Collaborate closely with quantitative developers to integrate models and pricing logic

  • Design and maintain ingestion pipelines for multiple live data feeds

  • Implement robust testing and monitoring to ensure system resilience

  • Build internal tools that support trading, operations, and analytics teams

  • Contribute to technical strategy and long‑term platform evolution

  • Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and engineering excellence

Requirements

Core Requirements

  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience

  • Deep proficiency in Python for production systems

  • Experience with low‑latency, real‑time, or high‑throughput systems

  • Background in multi‑feed ingestion architectures

  • Strong understanding of microservices and distributed systems

  • Experience deploying and operating systems in AWS

  • Familiarity with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL)

  • Experience with analytical stores (Snowflake, ClickHouse)

  • Strong knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working cross‑functionally

Bonus Points

  • Experience with pricing engines, trading algorithms, or live odds generation

  • Interest in sports and sport analytics

  • Familiarity with game state feeds such-as Radar & Genius

  • Prior hands-on experience in sportsbook platforms is highly desirable

Who you are

  • Self-driven and comfortable owning large areas of the system

  • Meticulous in your approach to testing, reliability, and performance

  • Able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

  • Excited by complex technical challenges and real-time systems

What’s In It for You?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits.

  • Flexible vacation allowance.

  • A hybrid / remote working environment.

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

13331.description_html:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

Staff Backend Engineer who blends systems thinking with product pragmatism and a real passion for crypto. You’ll design, maintain, and evolve the backend services and APIs that connect Phantom Cash to blockchains. You understand both client-server architecture and blockchain protocols, and you know how to balance reliability, quality, and speed. You communicate clearly across pods, document rigorously, and elevate the engineering bar through execution and mentorship. Your work will make Phantom Cash feel dependable, seamless, and ready to scale.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset, focuses on results and user impact, not abstract purity.

  • Proactive and outcome-oriented: anticipates problems, pushes features to completion without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Strong communicator and pragmatic problem solver - explains complexity simply, favors progress over perfection.

  • Node.js / NestJS at scale; event-driven design (queues, retries, idempotency).

  • REST API architecture: versioning, pagination, error models, authentication, rate-limiting.

  • Full-stack awareness: understands trade-offs of state management (client vs server) and latency budgets.

  • Distributed-systems fundamentals: concurrency, ordering, retries, data consistency.

Nice to Have

  • Kubernetes + AWS ops; CI/CD; observability; on-call ownership.

  • Deep interest in crypto - keeps up with ecosystem changes, wallets, protocols, and security norms.

  • Previous hands-on experience in crypto or fintech (exchanges, wallets, payment rails, ledgers).

  • Smart-contract and protocol understanding: knows how on-chain programs interact with off-chain services.

  • Blockchain integration experience — Solana preferred, EVM acceptable.

  • Has shipped high-quality products in mature, high-bar engineering organizations.

Why Work with Us

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 7M+ active users in just over three years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation with a focus around the wallet experience!

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) - Employee 100% covered

  • Stipend for your ideal remote set-up

  • Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Monthly wellness benefit

  • Weekly meal benefit

  • Global off-sites

#LI-DNP

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

13288.description_html:
Parallel Software Engineer

Mountain View, CA / Hyderabad, IN / Remote

About DataPelago:

DataPelago is at the forefront of revolutionizing data processing for traditional analytics and cutting-edge GenAI preprocessing. We are building an innovative data processing engine that is transforming how Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Ray and others operate on diverse, large-scale data. Our team of engineers drive and adopt advances in hardware-accelerated computing, parallel processing of large-scale data, query optimization, distributed systems, compilers, machine learning, and cloud-native computing. We are looking for specialists to join our engineering team and shape the future of accelerated data processing.

The Opportunity:

As a Parallel Software Engineer, you will be a key individual contributor in developing advanced
parallel software that unlocks the full potential of diverse hardware accelerators including GPUs
and SIMD-capable CPUs. You will enhance functional breadth, performance, scale, and reliability of data processing operators that are integral to our data processing engine. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on a category-defining product and work with a talented team of engineers.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect: Influence the architecture of how our data processing engine harnesses the par-
    allelism in GPUs and SIMD-capable CPUs efficiently in processing diverse large-scale data.
  • Design: Lead design of functional and performance enhancements to operators and functions that are accelerated by our engine.
  • Core Development: Individually design, implement, test, optimize, and maintain parallel
    implementations of operators and functions on diverse acceleration hardware.
  • Innovation and Differentiation: Analyze advances in accelerated computing hardware, programming models, and related tools and ensure our engine extends technology and product

leadership.

  • Collaboration: Partner effectively with the execution engine engineering team in integrating
    parallel software components with the overall engine.
    • Continuous Improvement: Foster best practices in design and code reviews, testing, CI/CD,
    and issue resolution to maintain highest product quality, security, efficiency, & productivity.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience OR a Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 3+ years of relevant

experience.

  • 3+ years of deep technical experience in developing production applications that process
    large scale data using SIMD-extensions of CPUs (e.g., AVX), GPU programming models
    (e.g., CUDA, ROCm), or equivalent accelerated computing framework.
  • Demonstrated experience working with software libraries, development tools, and profiling
    tools specific to parallel and accelerated computing.
    • Demonstrated experience in troubleshooting and resolving functional and performance
    anomalies in both pre- and post-production scenarios.
    • Strong knowledge of computer architecture.
    • Exceptional programming skills in C, C++.
    • Extensive development experience in Linux environments.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a passion for performance optimization.

Location Considerations:

We value face-to-face collaboration, but recognize that talent can be found anywhere. Our engineering team works at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA, at our India office in Hyderabad, and at remote locations.

Why Join DataPelago?

  • Technology Leadership: Shape the architecture and development of core parallel data processing functions of our engine.
  • Cutting-Edge Innovation: Work on challenging problems at the forefront of accelerated

computing and data processing.

  • Significant Impact: Your contributions will directly impact the performance and scalability
    of our mission-critical platform.
    • Growth: Expand your technical expertise and scope of responsibilities working with other
    talented engineers and with a growing product.
  • Competitive compensation, stock options, comprehensive benefits package, leadership development opportunities.

Location: Remote / Hybrid (India)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Us:

We are transforming global logistics and operational visibility through our advanced B2B SaaS supply chain analytics platform. Our software ingests millions of data points daily - from warehouse inventories and transport telemetry to supplier metrics - and turns them into real-time operational intelligence. Our engineering culture values deep data modeling, high-concurrency architecture, and clean, modular code. If you want to solve complex data challenges that keep global supply chains moving, you will thrive here.

13449.description_text: About Bold Business Bold Business is an AI-first, delivery-first company building production-grade enterprise software, automation engines, and autonomous agent infrastructure. We build the way modern teams build: our engineers are not syntax-typists but Systems Conductors, who leverage advanced AI-agent developer environments to design, build, test, and ship production software at multiples of traditional manual velocity. The Role We're hiring Full-Stack Systems Conductors to own feature delivery across our flagship TechForce platform — spanning React/TypeScript frontends, Python/FastAPI backends, and robust PostgreSQL data schemas. You'll own high-impact modules from day one, but your true value lies in your ability to design robust databases, orchestrate complex systems, and lead background coding agents through rigorous, test-driven implementations. Two principles define how we work, and we hire for both explicitly: AI-Agentic Command. AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code CLI, OpenClaw / Hermes Agents / Grokbot / other personal agent harnesses, and custom Model Context Protocol servers) are our native workspace, not a novelty. We expect you to command agents to write boilerplate, scaffold routes, and draft test suites. You provide the system architecture, the security guardrails, and the rigorous critical review. Speed from agents, judgment from you. Collaborative by Default. Every change is strictly peer-reviewed through pull requests. Documentation and automated unit tests ship in the same PR as the code. Blockers get raised early, not discovered at review. We value highly legible, standardized architectures that outlive their author's immediate attention — brilliant work that only its author understands is a liability here, not an asset. What You'll Do * Architect schema-first features: design strict API boundaries, typed contracts, and database schemas first, providing the structure background AI agents need to implement features safely * Build and secure module workflows: own recruiter and admin interfaces (screens, tables, profiles, forms, filters, dashboards), REST endpoints, and PostgreSQL relational workflows — with business security and authorization policies strictly enforced at the data layer * Establish codebase context: build and use MCP servers and AST-based dependency graphs to give developer agents standardized, structured access to our repositories * Orchestrate quality loops: set up local testing environments and containerized CI/CD checks where background agents automatically execute test runs, linting, and type validation before any merge * Engage directly with stakeholders: sit with non-technical stakeholders to translate messy operational processes into clean, executable technical requirements — and keep them in the loop as the work progresses * Stabilize and maintain the platform: production defects, small-to-medium gaps, and reporting migration support as Power BI is retired * Review and be reviewed: give and receive pull-request review as a normal working rhythm, with test evidence on every ticket Non-Negotiables We'll ask you to demonstrate all of the following — come ready with real examples: 1. Active agentic developer loop. You've transitioned beyond copy-pasting code blocks from a browser window. You can walk us through your CLI-native agentic loop: how you coordinate agents, what parameters and guardrails you set, and — specifically — a time you caught and patched an LLM hallucination before it shipped. "I've tried Copilot" is not this. 2. Collaboration you can prove. A working history of PR reviews given and received, documentation you wrote that someone else actually used, and a time you escalated a blocker early instead of grinding on it alone. We will check for this specifically. 3. Full-stack competency, production-grade. Strong React/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI experience on real systems in real use — not tutorials or side scripts. 4. Database schema and security mastery. Highly fluent in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, transactional isolation. You understand why hiding a button in React is not an authorization control; authorization is enforced in the data layer. 5. Clean systems architecture. You build robust, decoupled state machines (FastAPI, React state, background queues) that gracefully isolate, log, and recover from real-world API and network failures. 6. Enterprise systems awareness. You've designed, maintained, or operated within ERP-class platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or comparable) — or can clearly demonstrate how they work and why they matter: integrated data, standardized process, and a single operational source of truth. You'll help build a platform that plays exactly this role, so you need to understand what it replaces and what it must not break. 7. True Agile and continuous improvement. Not standup theater — iterative delivery, working software shipped in small increments, retrospectives that actually change how the team works. Come ready to describe a real process improvement you drove based on what a sprint or a failure taught you. 8. End-to-end micro-project ownership. You'll run micro-projects through their full lifecycle: planning and requirements gathering with stakeholders, implementation, testing, and maintenance afterward — documenting your work and processes clearly enough that another team member can be trained to support and back up what you built without you in the room. Come ready to walk us through one project you carried from first conversation to steady-state maintenance. 9. Strong English communication, written and spoken. You'll operate in a U.S.-based team environment and explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have * Hands-on experience with OpenClaw, Hermes Agents, or Grokbot agent platforms * Familiarity with LangGraph or stateful multi-agent orchestration * Operations-heavy SaaS experience (recruiting, workforce management, ATS, or CRM) * Multi-tenant application experience * AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, cloud logs) * Data imports, deduplication, search/filter interfaces, operational reporting * Experience joining a codebase mid-flight and getting productive fast What This Role Is * A hands-on builder-conductor role with defined module ownership * AI-accelerated delivery with human judgment on every merge * A high-performing team operating model: review, documentation, and early communication are the job, not overhead What This Role Is Not * Not a solo-operator role — if your best work happens when nobody sees it until it's done, this will be a bad fit * Not an ML research role * Not a role where AI tools are optional Compensation & Logistics Compensation based on experience. Standard options package per company policy. Target start: Immediately Final Note We will go deep into your past work — what you built, why you built it that way, what broke, and who else could run it after you. The engineers who thrive here are the ones whose systems outlive their attention: documented, reviewed, and understood by the team. Bold Business — AI-First. Delivery-First. Team-First.

Company Description

👋🏼 We're Nagarro.
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (17700+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We're looking for great new colleagues. That's where you come in!

Job Description

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Total Experience 6+ years
  • Strong hands-on experience in Workday Integration development and support.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday Extend, including custom business objects, custom fields, custom APIs, orchestrations, and UI/App Builder pages
  • Advanced expertise in Workday Studio, including complex multi-step integrations, XSLT/XPath transformations, Groovy scripting, error handling, and custom logging.
  • Strong experience with Workday EIB, including inbound/outbound integrations, custom transformations, scheduling, and troubleshooting
  • Strong experience with Workday Core Connectors and Cloud Connect for payroll, benefits, and third-party integrations.
  • Strong experience with Workday Web Services, including SOAP/WWS, REST APIs, RaaS, API versioning, and deprecation management.
  • Strong understanding of Workday Orchestrate and Business Process Framework for extending native business processes and implementing custom logic.
  • Working knowledge of PECI and experience supporting US Payroll and payroll/benefits-related integrations
  • Strong experience with Workday security configuration, including Integration System Users (ISUs), security groups, domain and business process security policies, X.509 certificates, OAuth 2.0, and SAML.
  • Strong experience in Workday reporting, including advanced, matrix, and composite reports, calculated fields, and RaaS.
  • Working knowledge of Workday Prism Analytics, including data ingestion and integration of Workday and external data sources
  • Exposure to Workday AI and automation capabilities, including Workday Illuminate, AI Gateway, Agents, and machine learning-driven capabilities
  • Experience integrating Workday with third-party systems such as payroll providers, benefits carriers, ATS platforms, financial systems, data warehouses, and middleware platforms such as MuleSoft
  • Strong experience with XSLT, XPath, Groovy, and complex data transformation and mapping requirements.
  • Experience with integration monitoring, alerting, logging, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting Workday semi-annual releases, impact assessment, regression testing, and remediation activities
  • Experience packaging and promoting Workday integrations and configurations across multiple tenants
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in Agile environments and managing multiple priorities/projects simultaneously

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support end-to-end Workday integrations across HCM, Payroll, Financials, and Talent.
  • Develop and maintain complex integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Web Services, SOAP, REST, and RaaS
  • Build and support inbound and outbound integrations with payroll providers, benefits carriers, ATS systems, financial platforms, data warehouses, and external applications.
  • Design and develop custom applications and extensions using Workday Extend, including custom business objects, APIs, orchestrations, and UI pages

13633.description_html:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

 

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

 

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.

*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

 

Responsibilities

  • Participate in end-to-end product development across frontend and backend under senior engineer guidance.
  • Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) into daily development workflow.
  • Translate product requirements into working implementations with minimal frontend-backend handoff friction.
  • Act as a full stack "seed learner" — absorb practices, contribute ideas, and grow into an autonomous full stack engineer.
  • Proactively suggest improvements to product, design, and engineering workflows.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree or above; Computer Science or AI-related major is a plus.
  • Hands-on project experience (personal, coursework, internships, or open-source contributions all count).
  • Foundation in at least one backend language (Java, Go, Rust, C++).
  • Familiarity with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks.
  • Basic understanding of database design and core backend concepts.
  • Ability to articulate requirements and constraints to AI tools clearly.
  • Self-driven, product-minded, and passionate about learning new technologies.
  • Strong logical thinking and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Open-source contributions or notable GitHub projects
  • Cross-platform development experience (iOS/Android/Web)
  • Internship or work experience at startups
  • Track record of proactively building internal tools or personal side projects

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

 

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

13630.description_html:
At Vyn, we're reimagining how work gets done in the deskless world.

Our platform enriches expertly-curated short videos — captured before, during, and after work — with AI-powered automated workflows. We own the world's largest dataset of this kind, enabling field users and customers to make smarter, more efficient decisions about their assets and operations.

Our purpose is to deliver transformative commercial and environmental outcomes, helping global clients across utilities, telecoms, retail and energy improve pricing accuracy, speed up delivery, ensure safety, and maintain compliance.


About the role

As our customer base grows, so do the volume and complexity of the systems we need to connect to. This role exists to expand our integration capacity. You will design and build new customer integrations and own the health of those already running in production.

Your focus will be on developing integration services that connect our core platform with enterprise tools across CRM, Customer Service, Field Service, Asset Management, Facilities Management, and related areas.

You will work across the full integration lifecycle: shaping the technical approach with customer-side engineers, implementing it with our Product and Software teams, and keeping it reliable once it's live.
What you'll do

  • Contribute to the technical architecture of each integration, working directly with internal teams and customer technical stakeholders

  • Design and implement integrated solutions for specific customer use cases alongside Product and Software

  • Build reusable connectors and packages for third party systems, as web services on AWS or as custom code on partner ecosystems such as Salesforce

  • Monitor, maintain and improve existing integrations in production, including diagnosing and resolving failures

  • Raise the team's technical bar through code review, testing standards and mentoring

What you'll need

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience with 2+ years building production systems in Python experience

  • Proven experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and owning at least one third party integration end to end

  • Strong automated testing practice, unit and integration tests as a default rather than an afterthought

  • Working experience with AWS, including compute, message queues such as SQS, and managed databases

  • Experience designing for availability, reliability and performance in distributed systems

  • Ability to work directly with external technical stakeholders and turn ambiguous requirements into a workable design

Nice to have

  • Salesforce or other partner ecosystem development

  • Multi tenant connector frameworks

  • Experience on Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools

  • Prior experience in a scaling B2B SaaS environment

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

We celebrate diversity in all forms and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need accommodations at any point in the hiring process, we’re here to support you.

13628.description_html:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and HealthTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing HealthTech company transforming the administrative landscape for major health systems and medical groups across the United States. By blending advanced AI-driven automation with expert human coordination, the team provides a sophisticated clinical command center that handles complex front-office functions like patient intake, intelligent scheduling, and referral management. Their HIPAA-compliant platform is designed to eliminate operational bottlenecks, allowing healthcare providers to shift their focus from paperwork back to patient care.

As a scaling organization, the team prioritizes measurable impact and high-fidelity technology that integrates seamlessly with existing healthcare ecosystems. They foster a culture of innovation and empathy, focusing on building tools that amplify human judgment rather than replacing it. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven company at the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare operations, dedicated to improving patient adherence and provider efficiency through smarter, more responsive technology.

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are seeking a high-caliber Fullstack Engineer to join a mission-driven HealthTech team dedicated to transforming patient care through intelligent automation. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building AI-enabled applications and scalable cloud infrastructure that directly impacts healthcare outcomes. We are looking for a systems-thinker who embraces modern AI-assisted development workflows to build robust, autonomous systems. If you thrive in fast-paced startup environments and are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology to solve complex logistical challenges in healthcare, this is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain and improve existing JavaScript/React applications and cloud infrastructure.
  • Architect and build new AI-enabled applications, workflows, and internal tooling.
  • Design and implement scalable APIs and event-driven systems.
  • Develop critical integrations with healthcare systems, telephony platforms, AI providers, and third-party services.
  • Utilize modern AI tooling and coding assistants to maximize development velocity and code quality.
  • Contribute to the strategic evolution of the platform toward autonomous and intelligent workflow orchestration.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional fullstack engineering experience.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work consistent EST hours to ensure team alignment.
  • Proven ability to operate independently and take ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • A strong problem-solving and systems-thinking mindset.
  • Deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Proficiency with Firestore/Firebase and REST API development.
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and containerized environments (Docker).
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with Vercel, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and Helm.
  • Knowledge of Python and CI/CD pipeline management.
  • Background in building event-driven architectures, microservices, or real-time systems.
  • Hands-on experience with AI SDKs, LLM integrations, and Voice/Conversational AI platforms.
  • Direct experience within the Healthcare Technology sector.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and observability tooling.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀 Career growth opportunities

📈 Long-term stability

🤝 Collaborative and supportive team culture

13625.description_html:
We are looking for strong Full Stack Engineers to work on large-scale systems. Serving millions of users across web, mobile and connected-TV devices.

The role will be part of the Subscriptions and Payments engineering team and will contribute to building Fire TV In-App Purchase (IAP) capabilities, subscription journeys, entitlement workflows and platform integrations.

You will work on highly scalable consumer-facing systems where performance, reliability, low latency and seamless user experience are critical, particularly during high-traffic events such as live sports and major content releases.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Java and modern web technologies.
  • Build frontend and backend capabilities supporting subscriptions, payments and entitlement management.
  • Develop responsive, performant user experiences using JavaScript/TypeScript and React or similar frameworks.
  • Build and integrate REST APIs and microservices for subscription and payment workflows.
  • Work on Fire TV IAP integration, including purchases, renewals, cancellations and entitlement synchronization.
  • Integrate with external payment providers, app stores and platform APIs.
  • Build resilient systems capable of handling large traffic spikes and high concurrent usage.
  • Improve application performance, availability, monitoring and reliability.
  • Handle failure scenarios, retries, reconciliation and user-state consistency across distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with backend, frontend, product and platform teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable and well-tested production code.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews and architecture discussions.

Requirements
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot and RESTful services.
  • Strong frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with React, Next.js or similar modern frontend frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of microservices and distributed systems.
  • Experience building high-scale consumer-facing applications.
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Exposure to caching systems such as Redis.
  • Experience with messaging/event-streaming technologies such as Kafka is preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
  • Good understanding of observability, monitoring and production debugging.

Experience

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong system-design and architecture experience.
  • Experience designing systems for high concurrency, large-scale traffic and high availability.
  • Ability to drive complex technical implementations end-to-end.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering best practices.

Note: This is a 6-month contractual role.


Benefits
  • Best-in-class salary: We hire strong talent and compensate accordingly.
  • Proximity Talks: Meet and learn from designers, engineers, product leaders, and AI practitioners.
  • Continuous learning: Work with a world-class team and stay close to the latest in AI, engineering, and product development.
  • High-impact work: Build AI-first systems and products used at scale by global clients.

About Us
Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media, and Entertainment companies in the world. We’re headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore.
Since 2019, Proximity has built high-impact, scalable products used by millions of users every day. Today, we are a global team of engineers, designers, product managers, and experts solving complex problems and building cutting-edge technology at scale.

13624.description_html:
We are looking for experienced Java Backend Engineers to work on backend systems powering the Subscriptions and Payments ecosystem.

The engineers will contribute to Fire TV In-App Purchase (IAP) capabilities and build services responsible for subscriptions, payments, entitlements and transaction processing.

These systems operate at significant scale and need to remain highly available, fault tolerant and performant during major traffic spikes, including live sporting events and large content releases.

Responsibilities
  • Design and build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Develop high-performance REST APIs and microservices.
  • Build backend capabilities for subscriptions, payments and user entitlements.
  • Implement Fire TV IAP purchase and subscription workflows.
  • Integrate with app stores, payment providers and external platform APIs.
  • Build workflows covering purchases, renewals, cancellations, refunds and subscription-state changes.
  • Design reliable, idempotent transaction-processing systems.
  • Handle retries, failures, reconciliation and eventual consistency across distributed services.
  • Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows using messaging systems.
  • Design systems that can handle high throughput and sudden traffic spikes.
  • Optimize service latency, throughput, scalability and infrastructure utilization.
  • Improve observability through logging, metrics, tracing and alerting.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed services.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews and technical-design discussions.

Requirements
  • Strong programming experience with Java.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem.
  • Strong experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL/MySQL.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases is desirable.
  • Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.
  • Experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming/messaging platforms.
  • Understanding of transaction management, idempotency and data consistency.
  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong production-debugging and performance-optimization skills.
Experience
  • 4-7 years of backend engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on Java and microservices development.
  • Ability to independently design and deliver backend services.
  • Experience working on scalable and distributed production systems.

Note: This is a 6-month contractual role.


Benefits

13620.description_html:
We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Senior Developer / Technical Architect with 12–15 years of strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, ABAP, RAP, CAP, and Fiori technologies. The candidate will be responsible for driving enterprise digital transformation initiatives, designing scalable and clean-core SAP architectures, and leading global implementation programs across business domains such as Finance, Procurement, Sales, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain.

The ideal candidate should possess deep technical expertise in modern SAP development models, enterprise integration, AI-enabled applications, workflow automation, and cloud-native extension development using SAP BTP.

Responsibilities

• Lead and architect SAP S/4HANA technical solutions aligned with clean-core and extensibility principles.

• Design and develop SAP BTP-based applications and extensions using CAP, RAP, Fiori/UI5, and SAP Build solutions.

• Drive enterprise transformation programs involving SAP ECC to S/4HANA migrations and modernization initiatives.

• Provide technical leadership across ABAP on HANA developments including CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, and Gateway services.

• Architect scalable integrations and extension frameworks using SAP BTP services and APIs.

• Lead implementation of AI-enabled applications, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, and enterprise portal solutions.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Ensure adherence to SAP best practices, governance standards, security guidelines, and clean-core strategy.

• Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, performance optimization, and solution architecture discussions.

• Mentor and guide development teams across global delivery locations.

• Manage vendor/partner coordination and support project governance activities.

• Support DevOps, CI/CD, transport management, and cloud deployment strategies within SAP landscapes.

Qualifications
  • SAP Core Technologies:  SAP ABAP on HANA (CDS) AMBDP), SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Gateway & OData Services, SAP Workflow, Adobe Forms, RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model), SAP Fiori / SAP UI5, OData APIs
  • Experience in SAP Clean Core architecture and side-by-side extensibility.
  • Exposure to SAP AI/Joule capabilities and enterprise AI integration.
  • Knowledge of SAP Cloud ALM and modern SAP landscape architecture.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery models.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and API-based architectures.
  • Exposure to multi-country/global SAP rollout programs.
About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Learn more about life at Nokia.



Our recruitment process

We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia.

13614.description_html:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

 


What are we hiring for?

The platform underneath our two biggest systems.

Workflows executes 21.5 billion automation actions a month from 3.1 billion enrollments. Conversations moves 2.6 billion messages in the same window. Together they run on thousands of pods, across 50+ kinds of deployments, on top of multiple database engines, GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, and Redis, with traffic peaking above 28,000 requests per second and growing double-digit percent every month.

Product engineers build the features. This role owns what the features stand on, the queues, the storage layers, the caching, the infrastructure, and makes sure it holds when the growth curve does what our growth curve does.

We're not looking for someone who knows one layer. We're looking for the engineer who understands the whole vertical: how a query plan behaves at 1.5 TB of indexes, why a pod eviction turned into a message backlog, what a Redis failover actually does to the request path. Databases, infra, cloud, you see through all of it.



Team & System Overview:

The Conversations organization powers multi-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads & Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build the platform components Workflows and Conversations run on, queueing pipelines, storage access layers, caching strategies, rate limiters, schedulers

  • Own your components end to end: architecture, design docs, code, tests, rollout, dashboards, and production health

  • Go deep on data stores at scale, schema and index design, sharding strategies, replication behavior, and migrations on live systems with billions of records

  • Work close to the infrastructure: GKE autoscaling, resource tuning, Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks topologies, and the capacity planning that keeps headroom ahead of growth

  • Spot gaps in your systems before production does, missing idempotency, unbounded queues, cache stampedes, hot shards, and drive the fixes

  • Debug the incidents that cross layers, where the answer isn't in one service's logs but in how the pieces interact

  • Write design docs and RCAs that make the platform's behavior legible to 80+ engineers building on it

    • The terrain:

  • Runtime: Node.js (TypeScript), Go, on GKE

  • Messaging & async: GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • Observability: metrics, tracing, and alerting you'll help make sharper

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep hands-on work in Node.js and/or Go

  • Strong systems understanding across the stack, application, database, and infrastructure, proven on high-throughput production systems

  • Deep experience with queueing and async processing, Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Cloud Tasks, or similar, delivery semantics, ordering, backpressure, idempotency

  • Database depth beyond CRUD, indexing strategies, sharding, replication, query performance, and safe migrations on SQL or NoSQL stores at scale

  • Hands-on with Redis or other in-memory stores, caching patterns, data structures, and their failure modes

  • Production experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, autoscaling, resource limits, and how they behave under pressure (GCP preferred)

  • You write clear design docs and rigorous test cases as a habit, not on request

  • Champion of AI-assisted engineering, you make agents produce accurate, production-quality code, fast

On AI

    We're past the debate. AI is part of how we build, and we expect you to be better at it than most.

    That means making agents do real work: producing code that's accurate, tested, and slop-free, fast. On platform code, the bar is higher, not lower: a sloppy merge here doesn't break a feature, it breaks the floor everything stands on. You review AI output with that in mind, and you ship at a pace engineers without this skill can't match.



What you're built for

  • You understand systems in depth, not just the API surface, but what happens under load, at the tail, when the network partitions

  • You've taken real production hits, a migration gone sideways, a queue that wouldn't drain, a database that fell over, and each one made your designs better

  • You're the engineer teammates pull in when the bug crosses layers, app, database, infra, because you can hold all three in your head

  • You write design docs people actually read, clear trade-offs, honest risks, a real recommendation

  • You treat capacity and failure modes as design inputs, not afterthoughts

  • When production breaks, your first instinct is curiosity, not panic

Bonus Points

  • You've operated systems at comparable scale, billions of events, thousands of instances

  • Experience with ClickHouse, ElasticSearch, or Firestore in production

  • You've done platform work before, the unglamorous layers everyone depends on and nobody notices until they fail

 

#LI-Remote #LI-HB1


EEO Statement:

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.
We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate. 

 

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow. 

 

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you. 

 

Job Summary:  As a Senior Software Engineer, the role is focused on developing and driving forward CisionOne’s media intelligence platform and the systems/processes required to support it. Working with the Ruby on Rails and VueJS frameworks and other relevant backend and frontend technologies, you will be part of a team of existing software engineers building and enhancing CisionOne’s desktop and mobile apps, support systems and will help to plan & design future innovations.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • Collaborate with CisionOne's Product Managers, Business Developers, Account Managers and customers to understand requirements of product features and business problems.
  • Design data and software structure to bring these features to life and solve these problems, extending existing components from the CisionOne architecture or adding new ones.
  • Discover and evaluate external libraries, services and APIs that can be leveraged to speed up development process.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery, applying sound judgement to review, test and take ownership of any AI-generated code.
  •  Write version-controlled code to implement the agreed solution, primarily with the Ruby on Rails framework on the backend and the VueJS framework on the frontend, following industry best practices and CisionOne's conventions.
  • Write automated unit and end-to-end test to validate the behaviour of the features.
  • Submit code for reviews of accuracy, maintainability and efficiency performed by automated quality checks as well as other engineers in the team;
  • Review code written by other engineers in the team;
  • Deploy code to CisionOne's preview and staging environments for testing and validation;
  • Gather feedback from various stakeholders and adjust solutions accordingly;
  • Merge and deploy code to production environments and monitor for unexpected behaviour;
  • Investigate and fix feature or performance issues reported by internal or external users of CisionOne's products;

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of experience. 
  • Working with the Ruby on Rails and VueJS frameworks and other relevant backend and
    frontend technologies.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot responsibly and
    effectively, with a critical eye for the quality, security and correctness of their output.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to lead and/or deliver on complex software systems.
  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot.
  • Understand software best practice and advise accordingly.

Preferred skills:

  • Some DevOps experience, particularly with Kubernetes and Elasticsearch.
  • Media/news/content experience is highly advantageous.
  • Experience working with Excel, Project Management Tools/CRM tools/Boolean Search.

Cision is the global leader in consumer and media intelligence, engagement, and communication solutions. We equip PR and corporate communications, marketing, and social media professionals with the tools they need to excel in today's data driven world. Our deep expertise, exclusive data partnerships, and award-winning products, including CisionOne, Brandwatch, and PR Newswire, enable over 75,000 companies and organizations, including 84% of the Fortune 500, to see and be seen, understand and be understood by the audiences that matter most to them.

 

Cision is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and perform at their best. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital to driving our culture, sparking innovation and achieving long-term success. Cision is proud to have joined more than 600 companies in signing the CEO Action for Diversity & Inclusion™ pledge and named a “Top Diversity Employer” for 2021 by DiversityJobs.com.

 

Cision is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected statuses.

 

Cision is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Cision will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact hr.support@cision.com

 

Cision, Inc. "the Company" only communicates with candidates and extends job offers through direct channels, not third parties.

 

Please review our Global Candidate Data Privacy Statement to learn about Cision’s commitment to protecting personal data collected during the hiring process.

13612.description_html:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Development Engineer with strong React and Python (with .NET as a nice-to-have) experience to join our Data Engineering team. You will serve as a key senior contributor, driving the end-to-end development of a new, critical internal self-service application. Your work on this software solution will be instrumental in our initiative to modernize how data is accessed and managed, enabling teams across the company to more easily work with their own data through the user-friendly tools you build. This project involves a shift from traditional data handling processes, with your primary focus being on creating a robust application that empowers this new approach to data accessibility and decentralized ownership.

About this Role:

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role suited for a detail-oriented and collaborative individual who thrives on ownership, knows how to apply best practices, and can independently design, build, and maintain production-grade software. While you'll be leveraging your core software engineering expertise, you'll also be at the forefront of our data modernization, gaining deep insights into modern data architectures and practices by building the tools that enable them. You will have access to AI tooling to assist in all aspects of the SDLC.

You will build a solution that provides these capabilities and more to our engineering and analytics teams.

About the Project: Data Self-Service Platform

The Data Self-Service Platform initiative addresses critical challenges in our current data operations. You will build a suite of tools that centralizes data quality and empowers analytics teams to drive insights. Specifically, you will develop a Self-Service Data Quality Platform that enables engineering and analytics teams to monitor pipelines, set up alerts, and maintain data integrity. Additionally, you will build an AI-powered analytics platform that allows analytics teams to automatically generate semantic layers and data models for use by analytic agents, accelerating time-to-insight and reducing manual dependencies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a full-stack application using React (TypeScript) and Python + gRPC/REST.

  • Build out frontend interfaces and backend services — including data models, APIs, caching, and observability.

  • Integrate with Kafka-driven pipelines and the Snowflake data platform.

  • Own the full lifecycle of the application — from architecture and implementation to CI/CD and monitoring.

  • Apply best practices for testing, logging, error handling, and scalability.

  • Contribute to infrastructure automation with Terraform.

  • Leverage Claude AI, MCPs and other AI tooling for assisted development and code reuse.

  • Mentoring other developers.

You will serve as a key senior contributor, driving the end-to-end development of a new, critical internal self-service application. Your work on this software solution will be instrumental in our initiative to modernize how data is accessed and managed, enabling teams across the company to more easily work with their own data through the user-friendly tools you build.
