Job Summary

We’re looking for experienced Backend Software Engineers to contribute to a project focused on training and improving next-generation AI systems.

You’ll apply your software engineering expertise to create realistic, challenging coding tasks for AI models to solve. These tasks may involve implementing features, fixing bugs, debugging complex systems, improving performance, and working with existing codebases.

You’ll also design and implement deterministic verifiers that can reliably distinguish reasonable, valid solutions from incorrect ones.

No prior AI experience is required — your software engineering expertise is what matters.

What You’ll Do

  • Create realistic and challenging coding tasks involving feature implementation, debugging, and bug fixes.
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world backend engineering problems.
  • Implement deterministic verifiers that accept valid solutions and reject incorrect solutions.
  • Analyze and work with complex codebases across different technologies.
  • Debug software issues and identify root causes of bugs and performance bottlenecks.
  • Review and improve code for correctness, maintainability, performance, and reliability.
  • Build and optimize scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Refactor existing code and implement complex features.
  • Apply strong software engineering and code review practices to ensure high-quality technical output.
  • Provide detailed technical reasoning and feedback to help improve AI model performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong backend development experience with one or more of:
    • Java
    • Node.js
    • Go
    • Rust
    • TypeScript
    • Python
    • C++
    • or similar languages
  • Proven experience building scalable services and APIs.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

13251.description_html:
About AutoZone

AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 6,000 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Brazil. Each store carries an extensive line of cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light trucks, including new and remanufactured hard parts, maintenance items, and accessories.
We also sell automotive diagnostic and repair software through ALLDATA, diagnostic and repair information through ALLDATAdiy.com, automotive accessories through AutoAnything.com, and auto and light truck parts and accessories through AutoZone.com.
Since opening its first store in Forrest City, Ark. on July 4, 1979, the company has joined the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AZO) and earned a spot in the Fortune 500.
AutoZone has been committed to providing the best parts, prices, and customer service in the automotive aftermarket industry. We have a rich culture and history of going the Extra Mile for our customers and our community. At AutoZone you’re not just doing a job; you’re playing a crucial role in creating a better experience for our customers while creating opportunities to DRIVE YOUR CAREER almost anywhere! We are looking for talented, customer-focused people, enjoy helping others, and have the DRIVE to excel in a fast-paced environment!

Positon Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team as a Senior System Engineer, focused on building and enhancing solutions within our Supply Chain Management (SCM) ecosystem, particularly Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Java Spring Boot microservices, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and UI technologies—React.js is a plus. Experience with SCM workflows and tools is highly desirable.

Responsibilities
  • Design and develop scalable microservices using Java Spring Boot for SCM/WMS modules such as task, inventory, order fulfillment, shipping, and logistics.
  • Architect cloud-native solutions on GCP using services like Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and Firestore.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to deliver robust supply chain applications.
  • Integrate and enhance UI components using modern frameworks; React.js experience is a strong advantage.
  • Work with SCM tools and repositories to manage codebases, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure high performance, security, and reliability of WMS applications in production environments.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
Qualifications
  • 7+years of IT Industry experience
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot framework.
  • Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP services and cloud-native deployment.
  • Familiarity with UI technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript; React.js is good to have.
  • Experience with SCM tools such as Git, Bitbucket, or GitHub.
  • Understanding of supply chain processes and WMS workflows.

  • Exposure to Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

    Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of security best practices in cloud and microservices.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools like Stackdriver, Prometheus, or Grafana.

  • Prior experience in logistics, manufacturing, or retail domains.

    Expectations

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact SCM and WMS platforms.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Collaborative and innovative team culture.
  • Continuous learning and career growth.
About Us

AutoZone opened its first AutoZone do Brasil store in the city of Sorocaba in September 2012. Our customer-first mindset and commitment to Going the Extra Mile define who we are, for both our customers and AutoZoners. Working at AutoZone means being part of a team that values dedication, teamwork and growth. Whether you're helping customers or building your career, we provide tools and support to help you succeed and drive your future.


AutoZone, and its subsidiary, ALLDATA are equal opportunity employers. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other legally protected categories.

13248.description_html:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.


The Know Your Customer Technology Team at Binance is dedicated to building a state-of-the-art platform that ensures a seamless onboarding experience for our customers. Our focus is on developing a large-scale KYC platform, launching innovative products, and integrating regional and global compliance vendors. We prioritize the responsible use of AI/ML technologies while adhering to both global and local regulatory standards. Join us and be part of a team that is at the forefront of innovation and compliance in the financial technology industry.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to convert business requirements into services with solid code and meaningful tests.
  • Proactively initiate performance tuning, troubleshoot incidents, etc.
  • Write and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
  • Write high quality code, follows best practices and advocates for engineering excellence.
  • Collaborate across other engineering teams and mentor junior members of the team.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in building high-throughput distributed applications.
  • Proficient in core Java and the Spring Framework.
  • Proficient in MySQL, and familiar with at least one NoSQL database.
  • Proficient in distributed system design, and familiar with at least one messaging middleware and the underlying design principles.
  • A quick learner with the ability to perform under pressure.
  • Able to collaborate with the remote team across different time zones.
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Performance tuning experience on JVM, SQL, RPC, etc.
  • Experience in KYC or Compliance is a plus.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)


Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

13245.description_html:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

CVS Health is seeking a Senior Varicent Integration & Platform Engineer with expertise in technical architecture and integration to join the Human Resources Technology team. This experienced and motivated professional will support Compensation business operations by delivering optimal, scalable technology solutions. As an integral member of the team responsible for the Varicent Sales Performance Management (SPM) platform, its integrations, and its technical architecture, this role will address the needs of Total Rewards and Human Resources business partners and stakeholders.


The ideal candidate will combine deep technical and platform expertise with a demonstrated ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical partners. The role will provide essential support to the Compensation organization for sales incentive technology needs and will collaborate with HR Technology, Centers of Excellence (COEs), and HR Shared Services across all business segments. This individual will establish cross-functional relationships throughout HR Technology and Human Resources to ensure that solutions and initiatives are effectively designed and implemented, with colleague satisfaction as a key goal.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with business and technical partners to support the Varicent technical architecture and integration roadmap, including the established list of global priorities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and operational support procedures for the Varicent platform.
  • Understand the needs of the business and evaluate platform capabilities through research and testing.
  • Maintain a clear and up-to-date list of key deliverables and timelines, develop plans to achieve those targets, and proactively communicate progress to a variety of stakeholders.
  • Ensure that the delivered product meets or exceeds the business' needs and business objectives.
  • Support enhancements, project requests, and defect resolution by providing optimal, scalable technical solutions.
  • Work with Architecture and Integration teams to design and implement end-to-end integration solutions between Varicent and enterprise systems such as Workday, Salesforce, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Configure, customize, and develop Varicent applications, including calculations, workflows, incentives, rules, and compensation plan components, and creates the necessary documentation at each stage.
  • Collaborate with key cross-functional partners to maintain transparency, consistency in delivery, and set expectations.
  • Actively participate in Varicent's vendor release process by engaging with the release team on cross-functional initiatives, liaising with business leads regarding critical impacts and upcoming enhancement opportunities, supporting regression testing, and guiding regression testing teams.
  • Maintain awareness of new and planned Varicent functionality, actively engaging with the vendor to prepare and communicate changes that could impact business.
  • Lead the translation of business requirements into technical solutions and create appropriate timelines.
  • Conduct fit-gap analysis and functional design; configures the application; supports user acceptance testing; and maintains the software solution.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in tracking tools, including architecture diagrams and integration specifications.
  • Perform and support user acceptance testing and creates the necessary documentation, including test plans, scenarios, cases, and results.
  • Ensure adherence to industry’s best practices, actively engage with the Varicent vendor community regarding future releases, and encourage product innovation and alternative approaches to business challenges.
  • Integrate relevant data and information, applies the findings to strengthen the Varicent platform strategy, and shares key insights and actions based on data and metrics.
  • Design, build, and maintain complex Varicent reports, dashboards, analytics, and audit capabilities to support operational and business reporting requirements.
  • Monitor platform health, troubleshoot issues, and drive root cause analysis and resolution for production incidents.
  • Establish and maintain platform governance, including security administration, access controls and compliance monitoring.
  • Mentor team members and promote engineering excellence through code reviews and technical standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years Varicent SPM platform experience, including calculations, workflows and configuration.
  • 5+ years of experience configuring and building integrations between Varicent and enterprise systems.
  • 5+ years of experience configuring and debugging Business Processes and building solutions in Varicent.
  • 5+ years of experience with calculations, complex reports, and various configurations in Varicent.
  • 4+ years of experience with Varicent integration architecture and design patterns.
  • 4+ years of experience working in the HR technology landscape, including cloud computing and mobile technologies.
  • 4+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining complex Varicent reports, dashboards, analytics, and audit capabilities to support operational and business reporting requirements.
  • 4+ years of experience demonstrating strong organizational, analytical, time management, and problem-solving skills.
  • 4+years of experience developing and sustaining relationships with business partners and stakeholders.
  • 3+ years of experience providing timely resolution for defects and collaboration with SaaS vendors to achieve this.
  • 3+ years of experience working with business partners to optimize their business processes.
  • 3+ years of experience working effectively in a team environment while managing multiple tasks.
  • 3+ years of experience demonstrating excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A strong work ethic, self-starter, and able to be highly productive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.
  • Experience supporting HR and Compensation systems for large organizations having non-exempt employees.
  • Project Management experience.
  • Experience with change management and communications.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree Required

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$83,430.00 - $222,480.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.  The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.  This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. 
 

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.


Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/15/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

13074.description_html:
Hey there! We're AKKO!

Our mission is to protect the devices the world relies on by relentlessly innovating to deliver an unparalleled digital insurance experience. AKKO enables partners and their end-users with modern and seamless protection solutions. We've become the #1 ranked provider in our space with industry- leading reviews and NPS scores.

With rapid growth and a fully remote team fueled by passion, innovation, and collaboration, we’re just getting started. Our investors—led by Mundi, Fika, and Pear—bring the same conviction that helped power companies like Doordash, Gusto, wefox, and Pipe.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET) to focus on our automation and manual testing of the suite of software products that we offer to customers. The candidate will be required to carry out tests to ensure the software we’re building addresses the business requirements and provides user friendly experience to our customers. The primary role is heavy on writing automated tests, maintaining them and triaging failures. This role will also include manual testing work for newer initiatives.

  • Build and maintain automated tests (Cypress/TypeScript preferred) across E2E, integration, and API layers; create reusable utilities/page objects and stabilize flaky tests.
  • Implement and own CI/CD test gates (smoke/regression) with parallelization and clear pass/fail signals; track coverage and test health metrics.
  • Perform targeted manual/exploratory testing for new features, edge cases, and UX flows; drive regression for critical paths.
  • Create and manage test data, mocks/fixtures, and environment configurations to keep tests deterministic and fast.

  • 5+ years in software testing with strong grounding in functional/regression and modern test design techniques (BC, EP, pairwise, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications and mobile apps end-to-end, including UX/UAT and bug verification across browsers/devices.
  • 3+ years focused on test automation, including designing scalable frameworks and CI integration.
  • Proficiency with Cypress (preferred) and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with API testing (Postman/Newman, supertest, REST/GraphQL) and at least one additional tool (Playwright/WebdriverIO/Jest/Mocha).

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit/integration/E2E) with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
  • Experience with Cypress specifically (selectors, fixtures, commands, intercepts, parallelization).

12817.description_html:
Job Summary :

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Full Stack Developer to join our technology team and contribute to the design, development, and integration of scalable, high-performance applications.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Node.js and TypeScript, with a proven ability to build robust backend services, develop modern frontend applications, and integrate third-party communication and collaboration platforms. Experience working with Zoom and Webex APIs/SDKs is a key requirement for this role.

This position is suited for a technically proficient professional who can work independently, take ownership of development initiatives, and contribute to architectural decisions, technical problem-solving, and end-to-end application delivery. The candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic, remote environment aligned with Barcelona working hours.

Total Experience : 5 - 8 years

Key Responsibilities :

Backend Development & Application Engineering :

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications using Node.js and TypeScript.

- Build modular, maintainable, and reusable code aligned with modern software engineering practices.

- Contribute to backend architecture, technical design, and implementation decisions.

API Development & Third-Party Integrations :

- Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs to support application functionality and external service connectivity.

- Implement third-party integrations using APIs, SDKs, and authentication mechanisms.

- Ensure seamless data exchange, error handling, and reliable communication between internal systems and external platforms.

Zoom & Webex Video Conferencing Integration :

- Design and implement integrations with Zoom and Webex platforms using their APIs and SDKs.

- Support video conferencing, meeting management, communication workflows, and platform-related functionality as required by the product.

- Troubleshoot integration challenges, authentication issues, API responses, and third-party service dependencies.

- Ensure integration solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with application requirements.

Frontend Development :

- Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend components using React.js and/or Next.js.

- Collaborate across frontend and backend layers to deliver seamless application experiences.

- Integrate frontend interfaces with backend APIs and third-party services.

Technical Ownership & Collaboration :

- Independently manage assigned technical tasks, from requirement understanding through implementation and delivery.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and technical stakeholders.

- Participate in code reviews, debugging, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Performance, Reliability & Maintenance :

- Identify and resolve application performance bottlenecks and technical issues.

- Maintain application stability, reliability, and code quality.

- Contribute to scalable application architecture and best practices for long-term maintainability.

12777.description_html:
Company Profile :

Infocusp Innovations is an IT firm working in the broad fields of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mobile and Web App Development, QA, and Signal Processing. Global presence in India and The United States of America with offices in Ahmedabad, Pune and California.

About the Role :

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer to design, develop, and scale robust backend platforms and applications.

Responsibilities :

Backend Engineering & Platform Development :

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous microservices architectures.

- Build and optimize data-intensive applications using PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB or equivalent technologies at production scale.

- Develop high-performance APIs and distributed systems to support AI-driven applications.

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps :

- Architect and manage cloud-native applications on AWS or GCP.

- Deploy and operate services using ECS, EKS, Lambda, Cloud Run, GCP - GKE, and other cloud-native technologies.

- Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or equivalent frameworks.

- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines for reliable and automated deployments.

- Manage and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

Monitoring and Observability :

- Instrument backend services end-to-end with metrics, distributed tracing, and structured logging using OpenTelemetry.

- Build actionable dashboards and alerting to detect latency, errors, and resource bottlenecks.

Requirements :

- 4+ years of experience in backend development.

- B.E./B.Tech/B.S. degree.

- Strong experience in Python development and FastAPI.

- Hands-on experience with asynchronous microservices architectures.

- Expertise in PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and distributed backend systems.

- Experience with AWS or GCP and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).

- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

- Experience with Apache Kafka for messaging, event-driven and distributed systems.

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.

12831.description_html:
Job Title: Senior Full-Stack Developer Polyglot Systems (Node.js, React, Python & Go)

Location: Chennai (Hybrid Permanent Role)

Experience Required: 6+ Years in IT (Minimum 4+ Years in Active Software Development)

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days Max

Education Required: Bachelor's Degree (Master's Degree preferred)

Job Summary:

We are seeking a versatile and technically proficient Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our core engineering group. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting responsive, intuitive user interfaces and building high-performance, resilient backend systems. You are a true polyglot engineer who understands the right tool for the jobwhether deploying real-time RESTful APIs in Node.js, automating data pipelines in Python, or building high-concurrency microservices in Go.

The ideal candidate is a Level 3 engineer who combines strong frontend craftsmanship with distributed backend design and containerized cloud-native platforms. You will develop component-driven UIs in React.js, write concurrent backend services in Go and Node.js (Express), automate processes using Python, manage relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Firestore) databases, and deploy workloads onto Red Hat OpenShift (OCP), OpenShift Virtualization (OSV), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Key Responsibilities:

- Frontend UI Engineering: Architect, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, managing complex client state via Redux, Context API, and modern React hooks.

- Polyglot Backend Development: Design and implement robust, secure backend microservices and RESTful APIs using the optimal language for each workload: Node.js (Express), Python, and Go (Golang).

- Concurrent Systems Programming: Leverage Go for high-throughput, low-latency services, utilizing Goroutines, channels, and idiomatic concurrency patterns.

- Database & Data Storage: Design schemas, optimize queries, and manage transactional data across relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL document stores (Firestore).

- Containerization & Platform Deployment: Package applications using Docker and deploy services onto Red Hat OpenShift (OCP), Kubernetes, and OpenShift Virtualization (OSV) environments.

- CI/CD & GitOps Integration: Integrate automated build and release workflows using Git, Tekton, ArgoCD, and configuration automation via Ansible / PowerShell.

- Code Craftsmanship & Quality: Enforce clean-code standards, participate in peer code assessments, write comprehensive unit/integration test suites, and uphold application information security best practices.

Skills & Qualifications:

Required Technical DNA:

- Polyglot Development Stack: Demonstrated proficiency in at least two core coding languages, with hands-on experience spanning React.js, Node.js, Python, and Go (Golang).

- Frontend & Backend Frameworks: Deep experience with React.js (Hooks, State Management), Express.js, RESTful API design, and Go concurrent patterns.

- Database Management: Solid working knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Firestore or MongoDB).

- Container & Linux Core: Strong background with Docker, Linux/Red Hat administration, and container orchestration on OpenShift / Kubernetes.

- Tenure: 6+ years of total IT experience, with at least 4 years dedicated to active full-stack software development.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):

- Cloud & GitOps Edge: Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Tekton pipelines, and ArgoCD GitOps continuous delivery.

- Virtualization & Automation: Familiarity with OpenShift Virtualization (OSV/KubeVirt) and automated provisioning via Ansible.

- Technical Communication: Proven ability to articulate technical trade-offs (e.g., memory overhead, concurrency profiles, and execution speed across Python, Node, and Go).

12465.description_html:
We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own and scale our multilingual data pipeline—from sourcing and curation to evaluation and continuous improvement. You’ll work closely with researchers and infra engineers to ensure our models perform robustly across languages, scripts, and cultural contexts.

This role sits at the intersection of data, research, and production ML and is ideal for someone who cares deeply about data quality, linguistic diversity, and model generalization beyond English.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain large-scale multilingual datasets across high- and low-resource languages

  • Develop data pipelines for collection, cleaning, normalization, deduplication, and labeling

  • Implement quality filters using statistical, heuristic, and model-based methods

  • Work with researchers to define language coverage, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics

  • Analyze dataset bias, coverage gaps, and failure modes across regions and scripts

  • Support training, fine-tuning, and distillation workflows with high-quality multilingual data

  • Continuously iterate on datasets based on model performance and real-world usage

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience as an ML Engineer, Applied Scientist, or similar role

  • Strong experience working with multilingual or non-English datasets

  • Solid understanding of NLP fundamentals (tokenization, embeddings, language modeling)

  • Experience building scalable data pipelines (Python, Spark, Ray, or similar)

  • Familiarity with Unicode, scripts, tokenization challenges, and language-specific quirks

  • Comfort collaborating with researchers and translating research needs into production systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with low-resource languages or multilingual benchmarks (e.g. FLORES, XTREME)

  • Exposure to LLM training, fine-tuning, or distillation

  • Linguistics background or experience working with native language experts

  • Contributions to open-source datasets or ML tooling

  • Experience with data quality evaluation at scale

Why Join

  • Real ownership over a core differentiator of the product

  • Work on models used globally, not just in English-speaking markets

  • Small, high-caliber team with deep ML and systems experience

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity at Series A stage

12466.description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own and push the limits of model inference performance at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production—turning cutting-edge models into fast, reliable, and cost-efficient systems that serve real users.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys deep technical work, profiling systems down to the kernel/GPU level, and translating research ideas into production-grade performance gains.

What You’ll Do

  • Optimize inference latency, throughput, and cost for large-scale ML models in production

  • Profile and bottleneck GPU/CPU inference pipelines (memory, kernels, batching, IO)

  • Implement and tune techniques such as:

    • Quantization (fp16, bf16, int8, fp8)

    • KV-cache optimization & reuse

    • Speculative decoding, batching, and streaming

    • Model pruning or architectural simplifications for inference

  • Collaborate with research engineers to productionize new model architectures

  • Build and maintain inference-serving systems (e.g. Triton, custom runtimes, or bespoke stacks)

  • Benchmark performance across hardware (NVIDIA / AMD GPUs, CPUs) and cloud setups

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and cost efficiency under real workloads

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in ML inference optimization or high-performance ML systems

  • Solid understanding of deep learning internals (attention, memory layout, compute graphs)

  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch (or similar) and model deployment

  • Familiarity with GPU performance tuning (CUDA, ROCm, Triton, or kernel-level optimizations)

  • Experience scaling inference for real users (not just research benchmarks)

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments with ownership and ambiguity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLM or long-context model inference

  • Knowledge of inference frameworks (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, vLLM, Triton)

  • Experience optimizing across different hardware vendors

  • Open-source contributions in ML systems or inference tooling

  • Background in distributed systems or low-latency services

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership over performance-critical systems

  • Direct impact on product reliability and unit economics

  • Close collaboration with research, infra, and product

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity at Series A

  • A team that cares about engineering quality, not hype

12464.description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on AI architecture research to help design, prototype, and validate next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production — turning new ideas into scalable, real-world systems.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys questioning architectural assumptions, experimenting with novel model designs, and pushing beyond standard Transformer-style approaches.

What You’ll Work On

  • Research and develop new neural network architectures (e.g. alternatives or extensions to Transformers, recurrent / hybrid models, long-context systems)

  • Design and run architecture-level experiments (scaling laws, memory mechanisms, compute trade-offs)

  • Prototype models end-to-end — from research code to training-ready implementations

  • Collaborate with inference and systems engineers to ensure architectures are deployable and efficient

  • Analyze model behavior, failure modes, and inductive biases

  • Read, reproduce, and extend cutting-edge research papers

  • Contribute to internal research notes, benchmarks, and open-source efforts (where applicable)

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning fundamentals and deep learning

  • Hands-on experience implementing model architectures from scratch

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Attention mechanisms, RNNs, state-space models, or hybrid architectures

    • Training dynamics, scaling behavior, and optimization

    • Memory, latency, and compute constraints at the model level

  • Comfortable working in PyTorch or JAX

  • Ability to move fluidly between theory, experimentation, and engineering

  • Clear communicator who can explain architectural trade-offs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with non-Transformer architectures (RNN variants, SSMs, long-context models)

  • Background in research-driven startups or open-source ML projects

  • Experience with large-scale training or custom training loops

  • Publications, preprints, or notable research contributions

  • Familiarity with inference optimization and deployment constraints

Why Join

  • Work on core model architecture, not just fine-tuning

  • Direct influence on the technical direction of a Series-A company

  • Small, high-caliber team with fast feedback loops

  • Opportunity to ship research into production

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

12467.description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for an ML Engineer focused on training optimization to help us scale and improve large-scale model training. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production, optimizing training pipelines for speed, stability, and cost—while collaborating closely with researchers pushing model architecture and capability forward.

This is a high-impact role with real ownership: your work directly affects how fast we can iterate, how large we can scale, and how efficiently we deploy new models.

What You’ll Do

  • Optimize large-scale model training pipelines (throughput, convergence, stability, and cost)

  • Improve distributed training strategies (data, model, and pipeline parallelism)

  • Tune optimizers, schedulers, batch sizing, and precision (bf16 / fp16 / fp8)

  • Reduce training time and compute cost via profiling, bottleneck analysis, and systems-level improvements

  • Collaborate with researchers on architecture-aware training strategies

  • Build and maintain robust training infrastructure (checkpointing, fault tolerance, reproducibility)

  • Evaluate and integrate new training techniques (e.g. gradient checkpointing, ZeRO, FSDP, custom kernels)

  • Own training performance metrics and continuously push them forward

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience training large neural networks (LLMs or similarly large models)

  • Hands-on experience with training optimization (not just model usage)

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Backpropagation, optimization algorithms, and training dynamics

    • Distributed systems for ML training

  • Experience with PyTorch (required)

  • Comfort working close to hardware (GPUs, memory, networking constraints)

  • Ability to move fluidly between research ideas and production-ready code

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale distributed training (multi-node, multi-GPU)

  • Familiarity with DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, or custom training stacks

  • Experience optimizing training on AMD or NVIDIA GPUs

  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure or research codebases

  • Exposure to non-Transformer architectures (RNNs, hybrid models, etc.)

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership at Series-A stage — your work shapes the company’s trajectory

  • Work on cutting-edge models and training systems at scale

  • Small, highly technical team with fast feedback loops

  • Strong emphasis on engineering quality and research rigor

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

12809.description_html:
We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our Funnel and Website Builder team, the group behind one of HighLevel's most heavily used and business-critical product surfaces. The Builder ecosystem powers the end-to-end experience for creating funnels and websites: real-time collaborative editing, rendering, publishing, analytics, AI-assisted creation, and global delivery at scale.

As a Lead Engineer, you will balance technical leadership with team leadership, spending roughly 50% of your time managing and guiding engineers, driving execution, and ensuring alignment and the remaining 50% contributing hands-on to building impactful features, improving architecture, and elevating code quality. You will steward delivery across multiple squads in the Builder ecosystem, partnering closely with product, design, infra, and security teams. You'll ensure smooth sprint execution, maintain engineering excellence, remove blockers, guide architects and developers, and ensure the direction of the product is technically sound, scalable, and stable. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for both people outcomes and product outcomes.

Responsibilities :

- Contribute directly to codebases across Vue 3 Nuxt, Module Federation, Node.js / NestJS services, and supporting infrastructure.

- Architecture and System Design : Design and review architectures for scalable, low-latency, high-traffic systems, including CDN and global traffic routing strategies.

- Routing and publishing servers : Caching and edge rendering layers; real-time collaborative editing pipelines.

- Stability and performance instrumentation.

- Lead architectural discussions and help teams make informed technical decisions.

- Identify stability risks, performance bottlenecks, and systemic reliability gaps and drive targeted initiatives to eliminate them.

- Work with infra/SRE teams to ensure systems meet global scale requirements across millions of daily page loads.

- Define architectural guardrails, standards, and best practices for frontend and backend services.

- Build impactful product features, performance improvements, and internal tooling.

- Prototype and ship enhancements to the rendering engine, builder UX, theme system, component framework, publishing flows, or AI-powered creation features.

- Debug complex production issues across distributed microservices, CDN layers, and global traffic patterns.

- Improve developer experience through better tooling, automation, and build pipelines.

- Manage and mentor developers across Builder squads, including performance management, career growth, and technical guidance.

- Lead and facilitate sprint planning, sprint creation, execution tracking, and sprint reporting.

- Work with PMs, designers, and engineering managers to translate roadmap goals into executable sprint plans.

- Review team deliverables and ensure engineering direction is consistent, maintainable, and aligned with long-term platform strategy.

- Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and set quality standards across teams.

- Ensure team velocity remains high, proactively identify blockers, resource gaps, or architectural misalignment.

- Encourage a culture of ownership, iterative execution, and engineering excellence.

- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to refine roadmap, prioritise work, and ensure predictable delivery.

Requirements :

- 7+ years of full-stack engineering experience building high-scale backend systems and complex UI platforms.

- Strong experience with Vue 3 Nuxt, Module Federation, and component-driven frontend architectures.

- Solid backend skills with Node.js, NestJS, event-driven systems, queues, and high-throughput APIs.

- Experience working with MongoDB, Firestore, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Nginx, CDN strategies, multi-region deployments.

- Caching systems, distributed architectures, proxy servers.

- Strong understanding of real-time collaboration, rendering engines, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant design.

- Ability to design systems prioritising reliability, maintainability, extensibility, and performance.

- Experience improving availability, stability, and responsiveness of large-scale production systems.

- Comfortable defining and working with SLOs, structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance dashboards.

- Strong debugging skills across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and distributed network layers.

- Proven experience leading engineers or squads, including mentorship and technical guidance.

- Ability to drive sprint execution, reporting, stakeholder communication, and predictable delivery.

- Excellent communication and ability to influence without authority.

- Collaborative, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.

- Thrives in fast-paced environments with high product usage and large-scale impact.

12463.description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on model distillation to help us build smaller, faster, and more efficient models without sacrificing quality. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production—taking cutting-edge techniques and turning them into systems that scale.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you’ll design distillation pipelines, run large-scale experiments, and ship models used in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement knowledge distillation pipelines (teacher–student, self-distillation, multi-teacher, etc.)

  • Distill large foundation models into smaller, faster, and cheaper models for inference

  • Run and analyze large-scale training experiments to evaluate quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs

  • Collaborate with research to translate new distillation ideas into production-ready code

  • Optimize training and inference performance (memory, throughput, latency)

  • Contribute to internal tooling, evaluation frameworks, and experiment tracking

  • (Optional) Contribute back to open-source models, tooling, or research

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning or deep learning

  • Hands-on experience with model distillation (LLMs or other neural networks)

  • Solid understanding of training dynamics, loss functions, and optimization

  • Experience with PyTorch (or JAX) and modern ML tooling

  • Comfort running experiments on multi-GPU or distributed setups

  • Ability to reason about model quality vs. performance tradeoffs

  • Pragmatic mindset: you care about shipping, not just papers

Nice to Have

  • Experience distilling LLMs or large sequence models

  • Experience with inference optimization (quantization, pruning, kernels, etc.)

  • Familiarity with evaluation for language models

  • Open-source contributions or research publications

  • Experience in early-stage or fast-moving startups

Why Join

  • Work on core model quality and cost efficiency—not side projects

  • High ownership and direct impact on product and roadmap

  • Small, senior team with strong research + engineering culture

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

  • Remote-friendly, async-first environment

Role Overview :

We are seeking a highly skilled Full-Stack UI Developer to join our Enterprise AI team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex machine learning models and intuitive user experiences, building sophisticated interfaces that allow enterprise clients to interact seamlessly with Generative AI and predictive analytics. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, backend engineers, and product stakeholders to translate intricate AI outputs into actionable business insights. Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. About Us:

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description:

Job Title: Interns

Location:   Hyderabad, Bangalore

Position type: Internship

About

insightsoftware provides the tools and resources to the office of the CFO to answer critical business questions to drive growth and ROI. The product offering consists of over 70 products (and growing) that provide solutions to companies of varying sizes. Users get real-time data to make the best decisions. Companies who use our products can understand overall costs, return on investment for those costs, and ways to improve their revenue and profit. insightsoftware is unique in that we offer such a wide range of products and solutions for the office of the CFO. Our goal is to better align and market these products for our existing and future customers.

Product Categories

FP&A Solutions – tools that provide real data for the company’s finance department to achieve financial planning and analysis needs

Controllership Solutions – tools that provide data reporting solutions for year-end, tax, and other required financial reporting

Capital Management Solutions – tools that provide insight into the company’s asset management and risk analysis for all equity management needs

Company Details

insight software was formed in May 2018 from two companies: global software and Hubble. Since then, the company has acquired an additional 19 companies (and growing). Products: 70+

AI First

At insightsoftware, AI is not a side tool. It's part of how we build software, and you will be expected to work the same way. You will be expected to use AI coding assistants and other AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as an occasional shortcut.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Use AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools) to accelerate coding, debugging, and test writing, while still owning the quality and correctness of what you ship.
  • Apply AI tools to speed up research, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Bring a curious, experimental mindset: try new AI-assisted workflows, share what works with your team, and flag what doesn't.
  • Understand that AI output is a starting point, not a finished product. You will be responsible for validating, testing, and improving anything an AI tool generates.
  • Get exposure to how AI is embedded directly into our products through Lineos, AI powered by insightsoftware, giving you a front-row seat to how AI-first thinking shows up in what we ship to customers, not just how we build it.

The people who do best here will treat AI as a thinking partner, not a shortcut. You will be expected to move fast while staying sharp about what you're shipping and validating.

Day to day tasks depend on the team you are part of. In our environment, the scrum teams are self-sustaining doing end to end work that contributes to the objectives of the scrum team. Depending on the role selected for and the team, you may do some tasks more than the others. Our teams develop software for multiple products and domain include technology platforms, web-based applications, high performance data drivers and business finance data.

  • Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software programs for enhancements and new products.
  • Design and code automated tests (functional, integration and regression), run manual tests, report metrics and defects.
  • Design, trouble shoot CI/CD pipelines, Manage the cloud (AWS) infrastructure
  • Code, participate in code reviews, testing, bug bashes, and Agile rituals
  • Work with the team lead to build applications, assist in Research activities and POCs

  • Exposure to databases and data modelling.

    • understanding of testing, test methodologies and how test fits into Agile methodology
    • Experience in design methodologies like OOAD , Knowledge of Design patterns

12977.description_html:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Staff Backend Engineer - NIRA

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

As a Staff Backend Engineer on NIRA, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of a critical domain within our credit platform. You'll lead a complex product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution, while working closely with our Principal Engineer, GM, and cross-functional partners across NIRA, Cashalo, and our US teams.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own a domain: Lead strategy, design, and delivery for a core part of NIRA's platform.

  • Set technical direction: Spot strategic needs and surface risks before they become problems.

  • Drive complex initiatives: Take large, high-stakes projects from design to ship.

  • Champion AI-native engineering: Push adoption of tools like Claude, Cursor, and Augment across the team.

  • Mentor engineers: Level up engineers up to Senior, and raise the technical bar in Bangalore.

  • Lead incidents: Own SEV1 and lower incident response through to resolution.

  • Bridge global teams: Align with Principal Engineering and peers across NIRA, Cashalo, and US teams.

  • Influence the roadmap: Shape product direction through technical tradeoffs, not just execution.

  • Simplify systems: Cut complexity out of designs before it compounds.

Why you're a great fit

  • 9+ years building web APIs, ideally in Java and Spring Boot

  • Deep experience with financial systems: state machines, complex lifecycles

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems and queue-based architectures

  • Proven track record scaling consumer products at high transaction volume

  • End-to-end ownership: design, execution, and reporting on your own initiatives

  • Comfortable deciding fast with incomplete information

  • A mentor who actively raises the bar for engineers around you

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI dev tools, not just tolerance of them

  • Bias for simplicity over clever abstractions

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

As a Software Engineer .NET at 66degrees, you will solve complex challenges to build and run AI, analytics, and other mission-critical applications for our clients. This role demands a strong foundation in .NET and working knowledge of Java or Python. You will work within cross-functional teams to develop scalable, cloud-native solutions and contribute to delivering measurable business value.

Responsibilities
  • Develop high‑quality .NET Core / .NET 6+ Web APIs using clean architecture and best coding
  • practices.
  • Build responsive frontend applications using React (preferred) or Angular, TypeScript,
  • HTML5, and CSS/SCSS.
  • Implement business logic, workflow rules, validations, bulk operations, and API integrations.
  • Work with SQL databases (Cloud SQL - PostgreSQL or SQL Server), create optimized queries,indexes, and stored procedures.
  • Implement authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2, and role‑based access control.
  • Integrate with GCP services such as Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, Cloud Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and support CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and Architecture teams to deliver end‑to‑end features.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, improve performance, and ensure application  reliability.
Qualifications
  • 3–6 years of experience building applications using .NET Core / .NET 6/7/8.
  • Strong understanding of C#, Web API, Entity Framework Core, and REST principles.
  • Hands‑on frontend experience with React or Angular.
  • Experience with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL/SQL Server), schema design, and query optimization.
  • Familiarity with GCP services: Secret Manager, Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, IAM roles, and VPC networks.
  • Knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Cloud Build.
  • Understanding of microservices, clean architecture, and SOLID principles.
    Good-to-Have Skills
  • Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and structured logging.
  • Familiarity with Excel processing libraries (EPPlus/ClosedXML).
  • Exposure to writing code through Cursor, Copilot etc.
  • Knowledge of Engineering/EPC deliverables.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
    Soft Skills
  • Strong problem‑solving and debugging abilities.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables

12972.description_html:
Software Engineer II

Job Description

Opportunity Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic and dynamic individual to join Upland India as a Senior Software Engineer I for our Upland InGenius product. The individual will work with our global development team integrating CRM and telephony systems.

At InGenius, we integrate Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software and telephony systems, hosted either on-premises or in the cloud. Much of our work is investigatory by nature, requiring a high level of curiosity and tenacity. We work mainly in TypeScript, and have a variety of browser applications, as well as an increasingly large footprint in AWS serverless technologies including IAM and Cognito, AppSync and Amplify and API Gateway, Lambda and Step Functions, DynamoDB and S3, with CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Graylog providing operational visibility.  

What would you do?

  • Develop new features using multiple technologies across both front and back end
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose issues with your code and production environments
  • Collaborate with team members to establish objectives and design more cohesive code
  • Own the development of a feature from start to finish
  • Balance technical debt vs feature development
  • Be an active participant in peer reviews of code
  • Adhere to coding standards established by the team

What are you looking for?

Technical Skills

The following skills are needed for this role.

Experience

·        4-5 years

Primary Skills

·        TypeScript, Angular and NodeJS

·        GraphQL

·        AWS Serverless, DynamoDB and CDK

·        Understanding of browser technologies and limitations, and  strong understanding of core browser technologies such as the DOM, CSSOM, rendering pipeline, and JavaScript event loop. Familiar with browser limitations including same-origin policy, CORS, storage constraints (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage), performance bottlenecks, and cross-browser compatibility challenges, with the ability to design efficient and scalable front-end solutions.

·        JavaScript build tools (e.g. Webpack)

Secondary Skills (nice to have)

·        API Design

·        AWS IAM & Cognito

·        Understanding operational visibility

·        CRM Development (Salesforce, Dynamics, ServiceNow)

·        Python & AI/LLM Skills: Hands-on experience with open-source LLMs and AI tools, including platforms like Hugging Face and models such as GPT, Claude. Strong expertise in prompt engineering to generate reliable, consistent, and structured outputs.

·        AI Developer Tools: Proficient in using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot etc., to accelerate development workflows, including code generation, refactoring, unit testing, and problem-solving.

Soft Skills

·        Thrives collaborating in a team environment with a diverse range of people

·        Passionate about delivering an amazing customer experience

·        Able to have a change of mind, and able to change the minds of others

·        Writes clearly and concisely

·        Capable of working without a company office, with a fully remote team

Growth Skills

·        Possesses a good work ethic; a self-starter with a desire to grow

·        Always looking for better ways to get the job done

Qualification 

This role requires overlap with multiple time zones for planning meetings, status updates etc. on a regular basis. The duration of these overlaps can change depending on the type of meeting. Upland India has the flexibility to manage your working hours accordingly to help in your work-life balance. You can find out more about this during your interview conversation.

Upland Software is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected status.

About InGenius

Upland InGenius enables companies around the world to make the most of their customer interactions over the telephone. InGenius technology integrates the most widely used CRM applications and the biggest telephony systems, both in the cloud and on-premises. Our success is largely based on being transparent to both agents and customers – when our product works well, our customers work better.

Our R&D teams are located internationally, with strong bases in Canada, Egypt and Pakistan with our customers being enterprise level. The team is small enough for employees to play a pivotal role in the development of our product, but we’re supported by a large global business, meaning it’s also big enough for you to learn and develop your skills within an experienced team.

About Upland

Upland Software (Nasdaq: UPLD) is a leader in AI-powered knowledge and content management software. Our solutions help enterprises unlock critical knowledge, automate content workflows, and drive measurable ROI—enhancing customer and employee experiences while supporting regulatory compliance. More than 1,100 enterprise customers rely on Upland to solve complex challenges and provide a trusted path for AI adoption.

Upland India is a fully owned subsidiary of Upland Software and headquartered in Bangalore. We are a remote-first company. Interviews and on-boarding are conducted virtually.
#LIREMOTE

12965.description_html:
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will be reporting to the Engineering Manager at Geographies & Marketplace Experiences - India Technology Center, who will guide you to grow and build your career path. You will be directly working within a team of dedicated engineers that work on the same solutions. You share your experience and technical expertise such that we improve on the longer-term technical strategic direction.

As a Senior Software Engineer for the Geographies & Marketplace Experiences team, you will be part of a mission critical team focused on building a high-throughput, low-latency, fault-tolerant Order Management platform that drives Nike’s Digital transformation and growth strategies.

  • A minimum of 7+ years software development experience.
  • Experience working in a highly collaborative, multi-discipline development team environment
  • Must have experience on Salesforce Service Cloud/ Apex and amp-script
  • Typescript proficiency for at least 4 years
  • Working knowledge of Java and relevant frameworks
  • Experience working in a distributed/cloud-based environment (e.g. AWS Services, GCE, Azure etc.)
  • Independently drive end-to-end project execution—owning design, development, cross-team coordination, and delivery
  • Experience in micro service architecture, domain driven design, SOAP and RESTful Services using Java
  • Experience with distributed processing of large datasets.
  • Demonstrate an AI-first mindset, actively leveraging AI powered developer tools (e.g., Cursor) to accelerate development and learning.
  • Experience in Test Driven development – with Junit, Mockito, cucumber, Playwright etc.,
  • Experience with monitoring and tracing tools like Splunk, SignalFx, Kibana/Grafana etc.
  • Experience with continuous integration, unit testing, static analysis, and automated integration tests. Continuous delivery experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Scrum and agile principles.
  • Working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment with globally distributed and diverse teams
  • Demonstrate end-to-end ownership of project/capabilities that includes requirements evaluation, design, implementation, code reviews, observability, maintenance and support.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other relevant subject area, or equivalent experience
  • Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins) and engineering hygiene: GitHub workflows (branching, PR reviews, code quality, collaboration) and release readiness
  • Observability and operational readiness using Splunk and SignalFx, including monitoring and alerting

The following would be nice-to-have:

  • Experience in designing and implementing highly scalable web applications
  • Experience working with NoSQL data stores like DynamoDB and relational data stores like MySQL, Oracle etc.
  • Exposure to digital commerce, omni-channel and Supply Chain domain areas like customer support/service applications, order management, fulfilment, and warehouse management

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

If you’re ready to innovate and lead in the Digital world, join Nike’s Global Technology - Geographies And Marketplace Experiences Organization. We bring together technology and process expertise to deliver the next generation of applications for Shared Platforms Services. You are responsible for building next generation tools and services that serve consumer ready product information to Nike experiences and back end teams. We are in the process of modernizing our entire product data platform, building scalable applications and services in the cloud. Our operations tools are used by hundreds of users across the globe to plan, prepare, and activate Nike products across multiple Nike consumer experiences.  Our product data services are being updated to unlock Omni-channel business cases, and support billions of API calls per month.  This is a team that’s always on the offense, working on innovative solutions and building world class solutions to serve Nike teams and consumers around the globe.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of the Shared Platforms Technology Engineering team, which is responsible for building next generation tools and services that serve consumer ready product information to Nike experiences and back-end teams.

In this role, you will

  • Participate in technical development and delivery of consumer service application leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud (a.k.a Agentforce Service) & backend cloud native micro services
  • Contribute ideas for new features and identifying technical areas for improvement proactively collaborating with product team members at Nike to design, develop, and deploy a highly scalable digital asset management system and services.
  • You will use your in-depth experience in software development to write clean, tested, and well-documented code, as well as perform peer code review process and mentor other engineers on the team.
  • You will remain current with industry trends and participate in development of key innovation features.
  • You will support the team’s agile practices, promoting continuous improvement and collaboration to deliver top-notch consumer experiences at scale.
  • Leverage GenAI powered capabilities (RAG, prompt driven workflows, MCP and spec driven architectures) to deliver faster, scalable, intelligent capabilities & experiences
  • Ensure quality of the code and products throughout the entire development lifecycle (DevOps) 
  • Ensure continuous improvement in performance, scalability, extensibility, reliability, usability, and availability of the platform
  • Leverage agile methodology concepts for quality, delivery and continuous improvement
  • Participate in sprint planning and other scrum ceremonies. Help team plan and execute sprint tickets
  • Work in full DevOps model in the entire tech stack including designing, implementing, deploying, monitoring, and operating services at scale
  • Resolve technical issues and remove blockers for the team
  • Actively participate in code review and feedback for other developers
  • Own build, test, release, and production support for team‑owned capabilities, ensuring stability, incident resolution, and continuous improvement
  • Implement strong observability and operational readiness using Splunk and SignalFx, including monitoring and alerting
  • Champion an AI‑first mindset, leveraging modern tools such as Cursor to improve test productivity, learning, and quality outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and platform teams across geographies, driving quality from design through production
  • Perform API integration, development and platform testing for Salesforce Service Cloud (a.k.a Agentforce Service) with Java‑based applications with synchronous and asynchronous integrations (Kafka, Amazon MQ)

12964.description_html:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world's best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At Nike, it's about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

If you're ready to innovate and deliver technology that powers Nike's global indirect procurement operations, join the Indirect Procurement Technology team within Finance and Procurement Technology. We design, build, integrate, and operate solutions that support supplier lifecycle management, third-party onboarding, and accounts payable processes at scale. Aravo is a key platform in our indirect procurement landscape—supporting supplier onboarding, qualification, risk assessment, and master data management—and we integrate Aravo with SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, and adjacent enterprise systems so supplier and payables processes stay connected end to end.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will work with stakeholders from Indirect Procurement, Sports Marketing, Logistics and Direct Purchasing,Technical  product managers, architects, engineering teams, and program stakeholders across Nike. Together, you will align technology outcomes to prioritized business capabilities and deliver solutions that support global indirect procurement, supplier onboarding, and payables processes.

You will collaborate with engineers across product squads and platform teams to design and deliver Aravo-based solutions, resolve technical dependencies, and improve service reliability, security, performance, and operational support.

You will also contribute to team health and engineering excellence through design discussions, configuration and solution reviews, pairing, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong engineering fundamentals with 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience and demonstrated experience in Enterprise Supplier Management space. Preference will be given for experience in Aravo configuration and setup experience. Ideal candidate will have experience working in Indirect (non-trade) supplier management space. Some experience in Direct (trade related) supplier management is desired. The ideal candidate is curious, collaborative, and comfortable working across Aravo configuration, workflow and form design, custom enhancements, integration design, testing, deployment, and production support.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 5+ years of overall experience in indirect procurement processes and enterprise procurement/finance technology solutions across design, build, test, deployment, and production support.

  • Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in configuration, enhancement, and troubleshooting of Aravo—including workflow design, form and questionnaire configuration, business rules, supplier onboarding processes, and platform administration.

  • Working knowledge of indirect procurement Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes, including supplier onboarding, supplier master data management, third-party risk assessment, and integration with downstream procurement and payables systems.

  • Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC integration touchpoints relevant to supplier master data, procurement, and accounts payable processes.

  • Experience diagnosing production issues through logs, traces, monitoring, and structured root-cause analysis.

  • Ability to assess complex technical information, make sound trade-off decisions, and communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences.

  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in an Agile delivery environment.

  • Experience integrating Aravo with SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, or other indirect procurement SaaS platforms.

  • Familiarity with supplier risk management, compliance, and audit-ready enterprise systems.

  • Aravo and SAP - MDG integration experience.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Indirect Procurement Technology team, you will design, configure, build, test, deploy, and support technology solutions centered on Aravo and its integration with SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, and other enterprise systems. You will translate business requirements into reliable, secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions that improve the end-to-end indirect procurement experience—from supplier onboarding and qualification through procurement, invoicing, and payment readiness.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Configure, extend, and support Aravo capabilities, including supplier onboarding workflows, questionnaires, forms, approvals, business rules, supplier master data processes, and related third-party management workflows.

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Aravo and SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, and connected services using APIs, integration services, events, and file-based patterns as appropriate—for example, supplier master data synchronization, onboarding status feedback, and error handling across systems.

  • Partner with product and business teams to refine requirements, evaluate solution options, and translate process needs into technical designs.

  • Develop high-quality, supportable solutions and participate in configuration, enhancement, and design reviews.

  • Create automated tests and support end-to-end, integration, regression, and production validation activities.

  • Troubleshoot complex application, data, and integration issues across Aravo, SAP, Coupa, and connected services; drive root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation.

  • Contribute to observability, operational readiness, incident response, performance, security, and reliability improvements.

  • Support Aravo and connected platform upgrades and release activities while assessing downstream integration and business-process impacts.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation, including solution designs, interface mappings, configuration guides, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

  • Participate in Agile planning and delivery, proactively communicating dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and progress.

You will translate business requirements into reliable, secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions that improve the end-to-end indirect procurement experience—from supplier onboarding and qualification through procurement, invoicing, and payment readiness.

Key responsibilities include:
