Configure, extend, and support Aravo capabilities, including supplier onboarding workflows, questionnaires, forms, approvals, business rules, supplier master data processes, and related third-party management workflows.

•
Design, build, and maintain integrations between Aravo and SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, and connected services using APIs, integration services, events, and file-based patterns as appropriate—for example, supplier master data synchronization, onboarding status feedback, and error handling across systems.

•
Partner with product and business teams to refine requirements, evaluate solution options, and translate process needs into technical designs.

•
Develop high-quality, supportable solutions and participate in configuration, enhancement, and design reviews.

•
Create automated tests and support end-to-end, integration, regression, and production validation activities.

•
Troubleshoot complex application, data, and integration issues across Aravo, SAP, Coupa, and connected services; drive root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation.

•
Contribute to observability, operational readiness, incident response, performance, security, and reliability improvements.

Support Aravo and connected platform upgrades and release activities while assessing downstream integration and business-process impacts.

Maintain clear technical documentation, including solution designs, interface mappings, configuration guides, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

Participate in Agile planning and delivery, proactively communicating dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and progress.

URL: https://www.steuartnutrition.com/

About us

Steuart Nutrition is a GMP-certified contract manufacturer making powders, liquids, capsules and stick packs for growing wellness brands. We run on Extreme Ownership, clear communication and fast turnaround, and we want a developer who works the same way.

The role

We're hiring a remote developer to own the customization of our training app. You'll learn the platform quickly, then build what our teams need to train and onboard people. Over time you'll also take on other internal tools and automations. AI-assisted development is central to how we work, so we want someone who uses AI tools to write and ship better code faster.

What you'll do

  • Learn our training app inside and out, then customize and extend it
  • Build features, integrations and automations with AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, Copilot and Grok
  • Turn rough requests from the plant and office teams into working solutions
  • Document your work so others can use it and maintain it
  • Give regular, clear progress updates

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of professional software development
  • Strong, proven skill with AI-assisted coding: you know how to prompt, check and fix AI-generated code
  • A track record of quickly learning unfamiliar platforms and codebases
  • Experience with APIs, web apps and integrations (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred)
  • Excellent written English and consistent communication
  • Able to overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern Time
  • Bonus: experience with LMS or training platforms, or with manufacturing or regulated industries

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/steuart-nutrition-software-developer-ai-coding

12479.description_html:
The Role

Tolken is a deeply technical team looking for a builder who craves complexity and ownership. You will work across the stack, from the core ledger to the user interface, ensuring systems are not just functional, but hyper-scalable, secure, and auditable. You will be hands-on in design, implementation, and deployment, collaborating closely with the founders to ship production-grade features in a high-velocity environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end features across backend (ledger, routing services) and frontend (React-based UI).

  • Implement and evolve production-grade APIs, data models, and integrations for a high-throughput financial system.

  • Own the full lifecycle of features: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing reliability in production.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Engineering, founders, and other engineers to translate product requirements into technical designs and delivery plans.

  • Improve performance, scalability, and observability of the platform through profiling, tuning, and better monitoring.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, and technical decision-making in a fast-paced startup environment

Stack & Core Requirements

  • 5+ years building high-throughput, distributed backend systems; you understand the difference between “working” and “production-grade.”

  • Strong backend experience in Python (FastAPI preferred), Go, or Java.

  • Strong command of modern frontend stacks (e.g., React) and ability to build complex, data-dense interfaces.

  • Deep understanding of modern database design; depth in Postgres and Redis is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (GCP preferred), containers, and Kubernetes.

System Architecture & Practices

  • Mastery of distributed systems concepts: microservices, idempotency, retry/backoff strategies, and eventual consistency.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and high-volume queues (e.g., Kafka, Redis Streams) and caching layers.

  • You build with observability in mind: metrics, tracing, and logging, and are comfortable working with modern monitoring stacks.

Requirements

Essential:

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack or backend-heavy engineer working on production systems.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one of: Python (FastAPI preferred), Go, or Java, including building and operating APIs.

  • Solid experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React), comfortable building complex, data-dense interfaces.

  • Strong experience with relational databases and caches; depth in Postgres and Redis is highly valued.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure (GCP preferred), Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and designing for reliability and scalability.

  • Comfortable operating in a low-structure, high-ambiguity startup environment with a high degree of ownership.

Desirable:

  • Web3 & privacy: experience with Ethereum/L2s, smart contracts, and especially zero-knowledge proofs (zkSNARKs) for privacy-preserving audit trails.

  • AI/ML: experience with graph-based models, fraud detection, or anomaly detection on live transaction streams.

  • Fintech DNA: background in payments, treasury, or other high-audit, regulated environments.

  • Prior early-stage startup experience and familiarity with rapid iteration and continuous delivery.

Who You Are

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don't just use tools; you understand why they work. You can reason from the ground up to solve novel problems in hybrid (Fiat/Crypto) finance.

  • High Velocity: You move extremely fast and thrive in high-ambiguity environments. You ship to learn.

  • Low Ego, High Output: You care about the product, not the pedigree. You are comfortable switching contexts rapidly—debugging a race condition one hour and designing a new API the next.

  • Owner Mindset: You don't wait for a ticket. You see a gap, you step in, and you fix it.

Equal Opportunities Statement

Tolken is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Originally posted on Himalayas

12469.description_html:
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER @ POPUTRUST

PopuTrust, LLC is a SaaS-technology “Big Data” business which owns the popular website which offers “Trusted People Search” services. Via its SaaS technology platform (www.poputrust.com) PopuTrust, LLC is focused on becoming the leading source of information about People. With over 10% of all Google searches now “people related” …people are more and more obsessed with “people”. PopuTrust is the comprehensive & trusted source of aggregated public information. As a “meta-search-engine” PopuTrust allows customers to search at just one location for multiple sources of digital content.

THE OPPORTUNITY: People Search is a massive Multi-BILLION dollar market. 12850.description_html:
ROLE OVERVIEW :

Teqfocus is seeking a Senior Software Engineer - Unity + Full Stack for a client-facing product engineering engagement. This is a hands-on builder role for an engineer who is equally comfortable in a modern full-stack codebase and inside the Unity engine, and who can move fluidly between the two within a single feature.

This role requires both competencies in equal measure : full-stack software engineering and Unity application development. We are not looking for a full-stack engineer who has only experimented with Unity, or a Unity developer with limited backend exposure. Candidates should be able to demonstrate production ownership in both areas.

The product environment uses C#/.NET, Vue.js/TypeScript, MongoDB and Microsoft Azure, while field applications are built in Unity using C#. Much of the work sits at the seams between these systems - for example, a Unity client communicating with cloud services or a web experience that must stay synchronized with what field users see in the application. The engineer will own features end to end across these boundaries.

The engineering team is AI-forward. Engineers are expected to use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalent as a first-class part of the development loop, while applying strong judgment about when generated output is production-ready, when it requires rework and when it should be discarded. Experience building customer-facing AI features is an advantage, but is not mandatory for this role.

This position operates as a senior individual-contributor role on a small, fast-moving engineering team, collaborating closely with product, design and customer-facing stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :

Unity application development :

- Build and maintain Unity (C#) field applications used to sketch, configure and publish pipe, duct and other MEP work from the jobsite.

- Write production Unity code across scene and prefab architecture, the component lifecycle, input handling, UI, performance, and the editor/runtime split.

- Own client-to-cloud integration paths including login, publishing and data synchronization between Unity clients and cloud services, with strong fidelity, resilience and error handling.

- Build and maintain automated tests using the Unity Test Framework (NUnit), including PlayMode integration tests and EditMode unit tests, and run them in CI as part of the merge flow.

- Help reduce handoff and stack-transfer fragility by treating Unity work as part of the broader engineering system rather than an isolated application layer.

Full-stack engineering :

- Ship customer-facing features across the full stack - backend services, APIs, data and web front end - working from product specifications and customer feedback.

- Design and build services and APIs that connect web experiences, cloud data and Unity clients, with reliable contracts and integration behavior.

- Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues by tracing defects across client, service and data boundaries and identifying root causes in unfamiliar code.

- Implement and maintain modern automated testing across unit, integration and end-to-end layers.

- Contribute to monolith decomposition, modularization and modernization as relevant touch points emerge in day-to-day feature work.

Collaboration and delivery :

- Use AI-assisted development tooling such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot as a first-class part of the development loop, including writing tests for AI-generated changes and validating output before it ships.

- Collaborate with product managers, designers and customer-facing teams to define, scope, design and ship features grounded in real design, fabrication and field workflows.

- Coordinate deployments and incident response with peers, and advocate for incremental, low-risk delivery.

- Raise the engineering bar through pragmatic code review, knowledge sharing and disciplined engineering practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS :

- Both Unity application development and full-stack engineering are mandatory. Candidates should be able to demonstrate hands-on production experience in each area.

- Experience : 6+ years of professional software development experience, including production ownership of customer-facing features and systems - not only prototypes or proof-of-concepts.

- Full-stack engineering : Demonstrated experience shipping across the full stack. Comfort with at least one statically typed backend language, at least one modern frontend framework, and both NoSQL and SQL data stores. Strong proficiency in C#/.NET, or the ability to ramp on it very quickly.

- Unity application development : Hands-on production experience building and shipping Unity (C#) applications, including scene/prefab architecture, component lifecycle, input and UI, performance, and the editor/runtime split.

- Unity-to-backend integration : Experience integrating Unity clients with backend services for authentication, publishing and data synchronization.

- Unity testing : Demonstrated experience using the Unity Test Framework (NUnit), including PlayMode integration tests and EditMode unit tests, with tests executed in CI as part of the merge flow.

- Debugging : Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to reproduce complex edge cases, trace issues across system boundaries and identify root causes in code you did not write.

- AI-assisted engineering : Hands-on daily use of AI-assisted development tooling such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalent, with disciplined judgment regarding generated code and changes.

- CI/CD and DevEx : Working understanding of CI/CD pipelines and engineering productivity. Familiarity with SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI and TDD, applying them pragmatically where warranted.

- Security : Working knowledge of secure engineering practices and safe handling of PII or other sensitive data.

- Communication : Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with product managers, designers and customer-facing stakeholders to triage and scope work.

- Education : Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE :

- Customer-facing AI experience, including production agentic workflows such as multi-step planning, tool calling, structured outputs or retrieval, together with the evaluations, guardrails and observability needed to ship them safely.

- Familiarity with an agent framework or SDK such as the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- Mobile deployment experience with Unity, including iOS/Android build pipelines, device performance and app-store release management.

- Experience working with CAD/BIM-derived data, 2D/3D model sets, or real-time 3D rendering and visualization.

- Experience decomposing monolithic applications into modular or service-oriented architectures, including event-driven or message-based integrations.

- Domain understanding of MEP, BIM, construction fabrication workflows, or an AEC engineering background.

- A bias toward experimentation, putting ideas into practice quickly and learning through incremental delivery.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

A senior engineer who can genuinely bridge Unity and full-stack software engineering, own production features across client/cloud boundaries, and bring strong engineering judgment to testing, debugging, delivery and AI-assisted development. The role is best suited to someone who enjoys working across layers rather than being confined to a single part of the stack.

12493.description_text:
**Stack: Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Microservices**

**About the role**
We're hiring backend engineers to design, build, and own services at the heart of our platform. This is a role for engineers who want hard problems: scale, concurrency, correctness under failure, and not a ticket queue. You'll own systems end to end: design, implementation, tests, rollout, and what happens at 2am when something breaks.

**What you'll do** 
* Design and build backend services in Go and Python that run in production at scale.
* Own service boundaries and API contracts in a distributed microservices architecture.
* Model data and tune performance in PostgreSQL; schema design, indexing, transactions, and safe migrations on live tables
* Solve open-ended problems where the right answer isn't written down yet: scope it, write the design, ship it, measure it
* Make systems observable, reliable, and cost-efficient; metrics, tracing, SLOs, incident response
* Review code and raise the engineering bar for the people around you

**What we're looking for**
* 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience
* Strong hands-on Go and Python
* Proven experience building and operating large-scale microservices; service decomposition, versioned contracts, async messaging, retries, idempotency, and debugging across service hops
* Solid PostgreSQL depth: query tuning, indexing strategy, isolation levels, migrations without downtime
* A track record of solving complex, real-world problems and owning them through to production

**Good to have**
* Mobile development experience (iOS / Android); a strong plus
* gRPC / protobuf, event-driven and streaming systems
* Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, or GCP
* CI/CD and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)
* Multi-tenant SaaS experience

Role Overview:

We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack AI Engineer to spearhead the development of next-generation intelligent applications that bridge the gap between complex backend AI models and intuitive user interfaces. In this role, you will architect and deploy scalable systems that leverage Agentic AI and Generative AI to solve high-impact business challenges. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional product teams, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into robust, production-grade software. By building seamless end-to-end experiences, you will directly influence how our customers interact with AI-driven insights, driving efficiency and innovation across our digital ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

- Architect and maintain high-performance full-stack applications by integrating Python-based backend services with dynamic React frontends to ensure a seamless user experience.

- Design and implement sophisticated AI agents that automate complex workflows, enabling the business to scale operations through intelligent, autonomous decision-making.

- Integrate Large Language Models and Generative AI frameworks into existing product suites to enhance feature sets and provide personalized user interactions.

- Lead the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from initial system design and prototyping to deployment and monitoring, ensuring high availability and system reliability for global users.

- Mentor junior engineering talent and foster a culture of technical excellence by conducting rigorous code reviews and promoting best practices in software architecture and AI integration.

Required Skillset:

- Demonstrated expertise in building scalable web applications using Python and React, with a deep understanding of state management, API design, and asynchronous processing.

- Proven ability to design and deploy Agentic AI workflows and Generative AI solutions that address specific business pain points and improve operational throughput.

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and lead collaborative efforts across distributed teams.

- Exceptional problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of navigating ambiguous technical requirements in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

- A degree in Computer Science or a related quantitative field, complemented by 7 - 14 years of professional experience in full-stack development and AI system architecture.

- High degree of adaptability and self-motivation, capable of thriving in a remote work setup while maintaining high standards of productivity and cross-timezone collaboration.

12461.description_html:
About Vantum

Vantum helps fractional operators win new clients while delivering for the clients they already have. When you’re managing several engagements, client work can consume the week and leave little time to grow your own business. We’re building Vantum to help operators make progress on both.

At the center is Ask Vantum, an AI chat that understands their goals, connects to their work, and helps them decide what to do next. It needs to remember what matters and help users take action without making them explain themselves again.

We’re a team of five, working toward product-market fit. We’re looking for an engineer to build and improve the prompts, memory, context, and backend systems behind that experience.

You’ll work directly with the founders and help shape a core part of the product.

What you’ll own

Your primary focus is Ask Vantum’s chat harness: the code and instructions that connect the model to conversation history, memory, app data, and tools.

  • System prompts and model behavior. Write, test, and refine the instructions that govern how Vantum responds, uses context, asks questions, and calls tools. Resolve conflicting instructions and make behavior consistent across different requests.

  • Context management. Decide what the model needs each turn, what to retrieve, and what to leave out. Preserve important information as conversations grow.

  • Memory. Separate lasting preferences from temporary instructions. Handle corrections, outdated information, and deletions so the assistant remembers accurately.

  • Queries and retrieval. Pull relevant tasks, goals, calendar entries, notes, and documents. Choose the right retrieval approach for the question.

  • Tool execution. Build actions that validate inputs, enforce permissions, and handle failures without creating duplicate work or claiming something happened when it didn’t.

  • Reliability and evaluation. Trace bad responses, reproduce failures, and verify improvements. Monitor response quality, latency, and cost while keeping client information properly scoped.

Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js App Router, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and OpenRouter. We have an existing harness you’ll improve and extend.

What we’re looking for

You have strong backend fundamentals and are good at getting useful, reliable behavior from language models.

You should be able to:

  • Write precise prompts. You’ve built system prompts and can explain how instructions, examples, tool descriptions, and output schemas affect behavior.

  • Debug beyond the prompt. You can tell whether a bad response comes from unclear instructions, missing context, poor retrieval, a tool failure, or application code.

  • Test your changes. You compare behavior across representative cases, track prompt versions, and check that fixing one problem hasn’t introduced another.

  • Build solid backend systems. You write maintainable TypeScript, validated APIs, scoped database queries, and safe persistence changes.

  • Show your work. You can walk through something you built, explain your decisions, and describe a failure you investigated.

  • Communicate clearly in English. Precise writing matters in system prompts, technical discussions, and PRs.

  • Take ownership. You clarify ambiguous work, flag blockers early, and carry a change through to verification.

Experience with chat systems, agent harnesses, memory, or retrieval is a strong advantage. A serious side project counts. Demonstrated ability matters more than years of experience, degrees, or employer names.

We want someone who follows developments in AI engineering and tests ideas critically. Tell us what you tried, what improved, and what you dropped because it wasn’t worth the complexity.

Why join

Ask Vantum is central to the product. Your work will directly affect whether users feel understood, trust the assistant, and return to it.

You’ll work closely with the founders, see feedback from real users, and have a say in how we solve problems. As you demonstrate your judgment and impact, there’s room to take on broader technical ownership.

We’re looking for curiosity, ambition, and follow-through. Someone who notices when the experience is wrong, wants to understand why, and cares enough to improve it.

A founder reviews architecture and sensitive production changes. You’ll have support while being expected to take responsibility for your work.

Compensation and working arrangements

  • $1,200–$2,000 USD per month, depending on demonstrated ability.

  • Full-time, remote position.

  • At least four hours of weekday overlap with Bangkok (GMT+7).

  • Potential for equity as the role develops.

How we hire

1. Screening call. We discuss your experience, work you’ve shipped, and what you’re looking for.

2. Repo and prep conversation. We share a repo and a problem to investigate. You’ll have the opportunity to ask questions, understand the existing system, and clarify the constraints.

3. Solution presentation. You present your diagnosis and proposed solution, including your reasoning, tradeoffs, and how you would verify the result.

AI tools are welcome. You should be able to explain your approach and adapt it as we discuss the problem.

Apply

Share something you personally built: a GitHub repo, PR, demo, or anonymized walkthrough.

Tell us what you owned and describe one chat, prompting, or backend failure you encountered: what went wrong, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

12471.description_html:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

What you'll do:

  • Own technical decision-making for the teams you support: evaluate technology options, run POCs and benchmarks, and make evidence-based recommendations on frameworks, datastores, and infrastructure —including partition strategies, migration plans, and performance validation at SaaS scale
  • Shape platform-level architecture: Kubernetes (AKS) deployment topology, Kafka-based messaging, durable workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant data models
  • Serve as an embedded architecture partner for .NET product teams: review technical designs, code, author/critique RFCs, guide teams through scalability and cloud-readiness problems, and help converge products toward shared platform standards
  • Mentor engineers across teams and raise the bar on engineering standards (GitOps, golden pipelines, observability, supply-chain security)
  • Assess established on-premises products for scaling, performance, resiliency, code quality, technology choices, supported environments, interoperability, security, and third-party dependencies, and define a realistic migration path to SaaS that does not disrupt on-premises delivery
  • Partner with Product Management, Support, and Professional Services to ground architecture recommendations in real customer and field issues, and review findings with those teams before publishing
  • Produce architecture artifacts — C4 diagrams, RFCs, design reviews, benchmarks — and present trade-offs to engineering leadership
  • Design, build, and improve microservices and backend systems for the SaaS platform using related technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, JDK 21+, and .NET. Follow sound cloud-native development principles, including API-first design, resilience patterns, and comprehensive unit, integration, and performance testing.
  • Turn recurring solutions into shared libraries, tooling, and examples that other teams can adopt.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, and design exploration. Review generated code with the same care as any other contribution, including correctness, security, and maintainability.

Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with a track record of technical leadership
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring ecosystem)
  • Hands-on experience with C#/.NET and sound architectural judgment, with the ability to review designs and code, provide design guidance, and help product teams address scalability and cloud-readiness challenges.
  • Working familiarity with Active Directory and Entra ID: domain services, LDAP, authentication protocols, and directory data models, with the appetite to go deeper
  • Comfortable reasoning about Windows-centric on-premises products (agents, domain controllers, customer-installed footprints) and the constraints of dual on-premises and SaaS delivery
  • Production Kubernetes experience: service design, Helm/GitOps deployment, jobs, autoscaling, multi-tenant SaaS operations
  • Comfortable with distributed-data fundamentals: partitioning, consistency trade-offs, high-volume ingestion/ETL, query performance tuning; hands-on with a relational database at scale (PostgreSQL, SQL Server or similar), plus exposure to at least one analytical or NoSQL store
  • Event-driven architecture experience (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), API-first design, and modern resilience/observability practices
  • Good documentation skills — comfortable producing RFCs and design docs and influencing teams you don't manage

Nice to have

  • Go, Azure, workflow engines (e.g. Temporal)
  • Experience with Spring Reactive
  • Exposure to identity security, such as ITDR, privileged access management, or identity governance

Our Values

At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

  • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

About the Role

As a Sr. Frontend Engineer, you'll work on a distributed team with diverse skills across the tech stack. We build features, enhancements, and experiments and deliver sustainable, quality software in an agile environment. You will also pair up with FEs and implement complex UI features.

What you'll help us achieve

- Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain quality software

- Review code and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback for your team

- Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other developers to build new features

- Analyze how your features are performing in production to learn and make the product better

- Support a highly available service

Who you are

Experienced Frontend Developer: With more than four years of experience, you're proficient in ReactJS and storybook with a deeper understanding of HTML, CSS, JS & TS. You've built frontend apps at scale.

Performance Expert: Making websites faster is your thing – you can improve performance and keep them that way over time with automated tools.

Testing Champ: You only call it dev-complete with automated tests, ensuring everything works smoothly.

Empathy First: You care about users, crafting experiences that make them smile.

Take the Lead: You're proactive and always ready to go the extra mile.

Agile: You understand how to balance quality & speed by being agile & can shift focus quickly with ease.

Clear Communicator: You're easy to understand, whether talking or writing.

Smart Decision Maker: You use facts and data to make decisions that work.

Great teammate: You believe in growing as a team & are ready to mentor and learn from your colleagues.

Bonus if you have experience with:

  • Complex data structures and data architecture.
  • Security by Design, and Privacy by Design principles.
  • React Native
  • Design systems

Our Tech Stack

User Facing Applications:

  • React.js
  • HTML
  • CSS (tailwind, MUI)
  • TypeScript
  • React Native
  • Vite
  • Playwright

Services:

  • ExpressJS with TypeScript
  • OpenAI, Python
  • GoLang
  • MongoDB
  • Redshift
  • Sisense

Environment & Infrastructure:

  • GitHub
  • DataDog
  • Amazon Web Services
  • Terraform
  • Helm
  • Kubernetes
  • Chromatic
  • Have more than 4 years of experience as a developer focused on frontend technologies

13007.description_html:
At Weave, we’re on a mission to elevate the patient experience by giving healthcare practices the tools they need to run more efficiently and meaningfully connect with their patients. With 30,000+ customers and growing, Weave’s all-in-one platform supports every interaction from scheduling and payments to communication and reviews making it easier for healthcare professionals to focus on what matters most: patient care.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll join a high-trust, high-impact team helping to shape the future of healthcare technology. You’ll work in a deeply collaborative environment, partnering with teammates across the U.S. and India to design and deliver resilient, scalable backend systems that power critical features in our platform. This isn’t just about building APIs, you’ll influence architecture, drive outcomes, and improve how 30K+ healthcare practices operate day-to-day.

You’ll thrive here if you care deeply about customers, lead with curiosity, and live by our core values: Think creatively. Stay hungry. Do the right thing. Care more. The customer is everything.

If you're excited about transforming healthcare with purpose-driven work and smart teammates by your side, we'd love to meet you.

  • This position is 100% remote while located in India

  • Reports to: Manager of Engineering


What You’ll Own

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Go (Golang) microservices.

  • Drive technical architecture and contribute to long-term system health by anticipating scaling and maintenance needs.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and frontend teams to deliver high-impact features.

  • Participate in system design reviews, propose and implement robust solutions, and contribute to Weave’s overall engineering strategy.

  • Own the quality, reliability, and observability of your code from development to production.

  • Help plan and execute projects from inception to delivery, with a strong sense of ownership and outcome-orientation.

  • Mentor peers and junior engineers by sharing your knowledge and encouraging best practices..

What You’ll Need to Accomplish the Job

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience with modern programming languages such as Go, Java, Python, Ruby, or C# (Go preferred or willingness to learn).

  • Experience designing and building ReSTful APIs and backend services.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and inter-service communication (e.g., protobufs/gRPC, ReST, NSQ).

  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation with your team and take responsibility for production systems.

What Will Make Us Love You

  • You’ve deployed and maintained services in cloud environments, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • You’re comfortable with Docker/Kubernetes, observability tooling (metrics, alerts, tracing), and service reliability.

  • You’ve worked with protobufs/gRPC, or Temporal, and have experience breaking monoliths into microservices.

  • You’re thoughtful about technical debt and scalability, and you write code with both today and the future in mind.

  • You value cross-functional collaboration and can explain complex systems to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You lead with curiosity, seek to understand before acting, and strive to elevate the team around you.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.

13000.description_html:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and HealthTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

About the Company

A fast-growing, post-revenue AI startup is building an AI-powered SAP Consultant platform for enterprise customers. The company works with DAX 40 and Fortune 500 clients

Job Type: Full-time

Location: On-site in Berlin, Germany

Job Summary

We are seeking a high-caliber Fullstack Engineer to join a fast-moving team dedicated to building production-grade applications from the ground up. This is a role for a true builder—someone who thrives on end-to-end ownership, from translating broad business requirements into technical architecture to deploying and monitoring robust systems. If you are a self-directed engineer who balances speed with architectural integrity and enjoys the challenge of integrating AI and complex data pipelines, this is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, build, and maintain complete web applications and backend services from concept through to production.
  • Design and implement responsive frontend interfaces, complex user flows, and internal dashboards.
  • Develop and manage APIs, background workers, scheduled jobs, and automated processing pipelines.
  • Integrate third-party APIs, LLMs (agentic workflows, tool calling), and data-ingestion systems, including authorized scraping.
  • Oversee cloud deployment, infrastructure monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high system resilience.
  • Perform load-testing and stress-testing to preemptively address bottlenecks and scaling issues.
  • Maintain a focus on cost-conscious engineering, optimizing cloud, database, and AI token consumption.

Requirements
  • Proven track record of end-to-end ownership, having personally built and shipped complete applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js).
  • Strong backend experience with Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  • Deep understanding of relational database design (PostgreSQL) and event-driven architectures (Redis, Queues).
  • Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, identifying the simplest viable technical approach to solve complex problems.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and risks to non-technical stakeholders.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience building AI-powered products or sophisticated data platforms.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) and NoSQL environments.
  • Background in developing SaaS applications, marketplaces, or high-volume search tools.
  • Experience with browser automation and large-scale data extraction

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀 Career growth opportunities

📈 Long-term stability

🤝 Collaborative and supportive team culture

12998.description_html:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

 

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

 

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.

*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

 

    Responsibilities
    - Participate in the development and maintenance of the company's core infrastructure products.  
    - Compile and implement interface documentation for business modules.  
    - Demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills to resolve issues reported by the QA team.  
    - Assist the Customer Success team in solving customer problems and classify them for system improvement.  


    Requirements
    - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.  
    - Solid Java fundamentals, with a good understanding of multithreading, networking, and common frameworks.  
    - Familiar with the Spring microservice ecosystem and its operational principles.  
    - Proficient in MySQL, as well as common middleware such as Redis, RabbitMQ, and Kafka.  
    - Strong logical thinking, teamwork, and a fast learning ability.  
    - Fluency in English is required to coordinate effectively with overseas partners.
    - Experience with open‑source projects is preferred. 

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

 

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.
12998.description_text:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.

*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

Responsibilities
- Participate in the development and maintenance of the company's core infrastructure products.
- Compile and implement interface documentation for business modules.
- Demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills to resolve issues reported by the QA team.
- Assist the Customer Success team in solving customer problems and classify them for system improvement.

Requirements
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- Solid Java fundamentals, with a good understanding of multithreading, networking, and common frameworks.
- Familiar with the Spring microservice ecosystem and its operational principles.
- Proficient in MySQL, as well as common middleware such as Redis, RabbitMQ, and Kafka.
- Strong logical thinking, teamwork, and a fast learning ability.
- Fluency in English is required to coordinate effectively with overseas partners.
- Experience with open‑source projects is preferred.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

12996.description_html:
The Company 

 

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we're ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.

Springboard is an education and workforce development company on a mission to bridge critical skills gaps by enabling individuals to access high-quality, job-aligned training. It offers flexible, mentor-led programs in high-growth fields including AI, Allied health, Data analytics, Software engineering, and more. Springboard partners with employers, healthcare systems, and workforce organizations to deliver programs that build durable talent pipelines, producing measurable business and workforce outcomes.

The Opportunity

Springboard is hiring Product Engineers: full-stack engineers who work directly with our operational teams to understand a problem, shape the solution, and ship a working product end to end. You won't be handed a spec. You'll sit with the people who run the business, figure out what they need, and own it from first conversation through design, build, deployment and iteration. 

GenAI is central to how we work, both in the products we ship and in how we write software.

Depending on experience, you'll join as a Software Engineer II or Senior Software Engineer. This is a remote role based in India. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in India to be considered for this position.

What you'll do
  • Work directly with operational partners to understand workflows and constraints, and turn them into scoped, buildable solutions
  • Own features end to end: data model, backend, frontend, deployment, instrumentation, and post-launch iteration
  • Build GenAI-powered capabilities (LLM integrations, agents, RAG, workflow automation) where they measurably improve outcomes for students or operators
  • Use AI-assisted development (coding agents, AI code review) as a default part of how you build
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: ship small, measure, iterate
  • Own the reliability of what you ship through testing, code review, production support, and paying down tech debt along the way
  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and scope decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • At Senior level: lead ambiguous, multi-stakeholder projects and mentor other engineers
What we're looking forMust have
  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in the industry
  • Strong full-stack skills: backend (Python/Django preferred) and frontend (React preferred; Angular or Vue also fine)
  • Solid SQL and data modeling
  • Hands-on production experience with a major cloud platform (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure fine): deploying, operating, and debugging services
  • Hands-on GenAI experience: you've built at least one feature or tool on LLM APIs (prompting, tool use, retrieval, evaluation) and use AI coding tools in your daily work
  • A track record of shipping products end to end, including defining requirements directly with business or operational users
  • Clear, direct communication with non-engineers
Good to have
  • Kubernetes (GKE) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with an LMS, especially Canvas
  • BigQuery, analytics pipelines, or event instrumentation (e.g., Segment)
  • Agent frameworks or MCP
  • Refactoring complex systems or decomposing monoliths
Why join us

You'll build products that directly shape how thousands of learners get through human-guided programs, with short feedback loops to the people using what you ship, and real room to apply GenAI to hard problems in education. If you like owning outcomes rather than tickets, we'd love to talk.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 

California Privacy Rights Notice for Job Applicants

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), Springboard is required to inform California residents who are job applicants about the categories of personal information we collect about you and the purposes for which we will use this information. This notice contains disclosures required by the CCPA and applies only to personal information that is subject to the CCPA.

12994.description_html:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your MissionUnderstand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join UsBuild Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

#LI-Remote

12992.description_html:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways. 

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Sitecore and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to join our Enterprise IT team. In this role, you will lead the architecture, development, and optimization of our enterprise digital experience platform, leveraging Sitecore and AI technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions. You will also play a key role in integrating modern headless architectures and AI-driven capabilities to create exceptional digital experiences.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will:

  • Platform Architecture & Development: Lead the end-to-end design, development, and implementation of enterprise Sitecore solutions. Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-performing applications while leveraging AI tools and AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
  • AI Innovation: Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI technologies that enhance development productivity, content management, personalization, search, automation, and customer experiences. Design and develop AI-powered solutions where appropriate.
  • Headless & Composable Development: Design and implement modern headless architectures using Sitecore XM Cloud, GraphQL, and JavaScript frameworks such as React and Next.js to build flexible, high-performance digital experiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, DevOps engineers, Digital Marketing teams, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Engineering Excellence: Promote software engineering best practices through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, performance optimization, and technical mentoring.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions adhere to enterprise security standards, data privacy requirements, accessibility guidelines, and governance policies.

What You'll Bring
The ideal candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building enterprise Content Management System (CMS) solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore XP/XM (including Sitecore 10+), Sitecore Experience Accelerator (SXA), Sitecore XM Cloud, .NET Core, C#, GraphQL, and modern headless/composable architectures using React or Next.js.
  • Strong proficiency with AI tools and hands-on experience designing, developing, and integrating AI-powered solutions into enterprise applications. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or similar platforms), large language models (LLMs), AI APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI agent development is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience designing scalable architectures, developing APIs, troubleshooting complex production issues, optimizing website performance, and mentoring developers within Agile teams.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering methodologies.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

Education/Certification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Sitecore Developer Certification is highly desirable.

Category: Information Technology

Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:
Join Walmart as a Staff Software Engineer to lead the development and delivery of scalable platform capabilities, including infrastructure, tooling, and AI/ML frameworks. This role involves driving the full software lifecycle, applying cloud-native architecture principles, and ensuring technical excellence through design reviews and mentorship. Collaborating across teams, you will translate complex business needs into actionable solutions while promoting continuous improvement and innovation. Your expertise will support engineering productivity and platform goals, contributing to Walmart’s commitment to operational excellence and technology leadership.
About the team:
The Technical Vulnerability Assessment (TVA) team is a key part of Walmart’s Information Security organization, focused on analyzing critical security exposures within a complex technology environment. Serving as the enterprise’s central hub for vulnerability data and analytics, TVA collaborates with engineering, data science, platform, and product teams worldwide to deliver actionable insights and drive timely remediation. The team’s efforts enhance Walmart’s security posture at scale by streamlining workflows, leveraging AI, and developing software solutions that protect one of the largest global retailers. TVA’s work directly impacts the safety and resilience of Walmart’s technology landscape.
What you'll do:

The Lead Software Developer will be responsible for team leadership and full-stack development of CFRA’s next generation of web applications using a modern technology stack: React and Python on AWS cloud infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to make a big impact on both the team and the organization by being part of the initial design and development of a new customer-facing application framework that will serve as the foundation for all future web development at CFRA.


The ideal candidate has a passion for solving business problems with technology and can effectively communicate business and technical needs to stakeholders. We are looking for candidates that value collaboration with superb colleagues and having an immediate, tangible impact for a leading global independent financial insights and data company.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality, high-performance, scalable applications using best practices and the latest generation of technologies
  • Mentor and work with a skilled team while shaping the future of our products
  • Work collaboratively with product and technical stakeholders to understand and clarify requirements
  • Provide recommendations for proposed solutions
  • Review and validate solution designs from other team members
  • Perform design, debug, and performance analysis on solutions
  • Provide technical leadership to a team throughout a project lifecycle
  • Follow Agile best practices effectively and actively participate in all scrum ceremonies.
  • Respond to and resolve production issues
  • Be part of a culture of continuous learning and improvement of both the team and codebase

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
  • A minimum of 6+ years of full stack development experience on enterprise web applications.
  • Proficient in frontend development using React/Typescript
  • Proficient in backend development using Python
  • Fluency in the AWS infrastructure for delivering web applications: API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, CloudFront, S3.
  • Proficient in SQL and developing solutions using relational databases such as MySQL.
  • Experience using object-oriented design principles and building backend applications with REST APIs
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
  • Experience with Git and continuous integration environments
  • Experience with code pipelines such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipline
  • Experience with frontend and backend unit testing methodologies
  • Proficient with software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies like Agile
  • CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) designation with hands-on experience in financial equity research is a strong plus, providing domain expertise in financial statement analysis, valuation, and investment research that translates directly into more informed design of CFRA's research and analytics platforms
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills are essential, with strong verbal and writing proficiencies
  • Great organizational and time-management skills, including an ability to estimate project completion times
  • Ability to take complex technical concepts and communicate to non-technical audience
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or Engineering is required

Benefits
  • 21 days of Vacation
  • 8 Sick Days
  • 1 paid volunteer day
  • 11 - 13 Holidays a year
  • Health Insurance
  • Company paid Life & Disability Insurance 
  • Competitive Pay
  • Annual Performance Bonus 



About
CFRA is a global leader in independent investment insights and data analytics. With a heritage dating back to the 1920s, we provide actionable analytics through a multidisciplinary approach—including forensic accounting, fundamental, and policy research.Our team of over 90 global analysts provides in-depth qualitative research on 1,600+ companies and 34,000+ funds, quantitative research on over 20,000 global companies. Headquartered in the US with a significant presence across Europe and Asia, CFRA serves over 2,000 clients. We remain committed to providing the independent, differentiated analysis our clients need to make superior investment and business decisions.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

Job Description:

3M Health Care is now Solventum


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.


We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications and APIs.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly front-end solutions using modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Develop scalable back-end services, business logic, and database integrations.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, architects, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver business solutions.
  • Participate in application design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Develop and consume REST APIs and integrate with enterprise systems and third-party applications.
  • Ensure application security, reliability, maintainability, and compliance with development standards.
  • Support production deployments, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, estimation, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of full-stack application development experience.
  • Strong experience with:
    • Front-end: Angular
    • Back-end: Java, Spring Boot
    • Databases: Oracle
  • Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Experience with Git-based source control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of software design patterns, secure coding practices, and application architecture.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and automated testing.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or manufacturing.

Work location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

   

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process.  Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of @solventum.com. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.
