Role : Forward Deployed Engineer - AI/ML & Generative AI

Location : Hyderabad, Telangana

Work Model : Hybrid

Employment Type : Full-Time

Experience : 2+ Years

Educational Qualification - Mandatory :

B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / M.E. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline. Degree must be from an IIT, NIT, or IIIT.

About the Role :

- We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer - AI/ML & Generative AI to join our Hyderabad team. The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals combined with practical experience in Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, and modern AI application development.

- This role is highly execution-oriented and involves working closely with customers, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand real-world problems, rapidly prototype solutions, and build scalable, production-ready AI applications.

- You will work with technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, embeddings, and cloud platforms to build and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities :

- Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into AI/ML solutions.

- Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Generative AI and LLM-powered applications.

- Build LLM applications using OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent LLM APIs.

- Design and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking, and response generation.

- Develop AI agents, tool-calling workflows, and intelligent automation using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable frameworks.

- Build scalable backend services and AI workflows using Python.

- Integrate LLM applications with enterprise APIs, databases, internal data sources, and business applications.

- Rapidly prototype AI solutions and transition successful prototypes into reliable, maintainable production systems.

- Experiment with prompt engineering, context management, model selection, retrieval strategies, and LLM evaluation.

- Improve AI application accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

- Develop evaluation and monitoring mechanisms for LLM and RAG applications.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges across AI applications, integrations, and deployments.

- Collaborate with product, engineering, data, and business teams to deliver customer-focused AI solutions.

- Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, embeddings, and emerging AI technologies.

Mandatory Skills :

- 2+ years of professional experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, NLP, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Strong hands-on proficiency in Python.

- Practical experience working with LLM APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent.

- Strong hands-on experience with RAG architectures and applications.

- Experience with LangChain and/or LlamaIndex.

- Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, information retrieval, and document processing.

- Good understanding of Machine Learning and NLP fundamentals.

- Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and AI services.

- Strong software engineering, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Ability to write clean, scalable, maintainable, and production-quality code.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and business stakeholders.

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and solve ambiguous, real-world problems.

12183.description_html:
gravity9 is a boutique IT consulting company headquartered in the UK with offices in the US, Canada, Poland, and Colombia. Our team has deep experience in engineering, experience design and product management. We enjoy a challenge and pride ourselves on working with our clients on their most complex problems, finding elegant and flexible solutions that help them transform their businesses.

Join Our Growing Team - Future Opportunities Await!

We are excited to share that our company is experiencing significant growth and expansion, and as a result, we're on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

We want to be upfront about our hiring process. At this moment, we are in the process of securing projects that align with our business goals and objectives. Our intention is to ensure that once we bring new team members on board, they will have a meaningful and impactful role to play from day one. While we might not be able to extend an offer immediately, we are highly interested in considering you for these future projects.

If you're open to the idea of potentially joining our team in the future, we encourage you to continue with our interview process. We value your time and effort and believe that getting to know you better will help us make an informed decision.

Once you have effectively concluded the entire recruitment procedure, we will retain your profile and reach out to you once a suitable opportunity emerges. Additional interviews will not be necessary at this stage, and we anticipate being able to extend an offer to you promptly.

What does the recruitment process look like?

1. Recruiter Screen

In the first call, our recruiter will learn more about you and your story to check a potential fit for gravity9. This is also an opportunity to ask your questions about the role and company. This step might take around 60 mins.

2. Tech 1 Interview with our AI Practice Lead

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 60 mins.

3. Tech 2 Interview with our software consultants

In this meeting your potential future teammate will take a deeper dive into your experience and what you could bring to the team.

This step will take around 60 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

The salary details for the role will be communicated ahead of the first recruitment meeting.

Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things.

Role Description

We are looking for a smart, enthusiastic AI/ML Engineer or Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to solve complex problems. As an integral member of our team, you'll be responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and deploying innovative AI/ML solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on diverse projects, providing bespoke solutions to our clients.

We believe small, multi-disciplinary teams are most effective in delivering complex change. As such, we are looking for someone with a collaborative mindset who is happy to be flexible and take on different responsibilities over the lifetime of our projects.

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be an experienced developer with a strong interest in state-of-the-art AI and Machine Learning technologies. You’ll be primarily “hands-on” and actively providing technical expertise across a broad range of AI/ML disciplines, developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Engage with clients to understand their unique challenges and deliver tailored AI/ML solutions.

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, efficient, and robust end-to-end ML/AI systems.

  • Manage the entire ML/AI development lifecycle, including planning, pipeline management, and deployment.

  • Provide technical support to engineering team members, promoting best practices in ML engineering.

  • Collaborate with AI Practice Lead to inform and shape the company's AI strategic direction.

Requirements

Role requirements - technical skills and experience

This role will suit a highly capable AI/ML Engineer with at least 5 years of experience. Skills and experience should include:

  • Extensive experience in AI/ML development, particularly in NLP, and machine learning domains.

  • Hands-on experience in developing AI applications using LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and particularly agentic AI solutions is essential

  • Proficiency in designing and maintaining AI/ML solutions that are cost-effective, accurate, and scalable.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the aptitude to navigate complex project requirements with clients and stakeholders.

  • A growth mindset with a commitment to personal and professional development.

  • Excellent command/highly proficient in spoken and written English (working directly with UK/US based clients).

Essential skills:

  • Advanced knowledge of Python specifically for machine learning and data science.

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.

  • Proficiency in cloud services related to ML/AI (e.g., Azure, OpenAI, Hugging Face, AWS, GCP).

Nice to have:

  • Certification as an Azure AI Engineer Associate or equivalent credentials is highly advantageous.

  • AWS Professional Certifications.

  • Experience with ML/DL frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

  • Experience with C# or Java, node.js.

  • Knowledge in MLOps, encompassing the ML applications development lifecycle and toolsets.

  • Robust software engineering background, with a track record of leading agile teams and expedited delivery of complex projects.

  • Leadership experience.

Role requirements – soft skills
Key attributes and behaviours to succeed in this role will be:

  • Customer Focus – passion for understanding the problem we are trying to solve with software and to advocate solutions to your client.

  • Delivery focus - strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate, design and implement effective solutions. Flexibility to adapt skills to a spectrum of client engagements, use cases and modes of change delivery.

  • Exemplary standards of personal integrity and respect for others – professional approach to all aspects of client engagement and collaborative team working, able to quickly build relationships based on trust and transparency. Strong presentation and written and verbal communication are essential given the client facing nature of the role.

  • Value driven - Creative thinking, with aptitude for innovation and strong desire to exceed client expectations.

  • Energy – positive attitude and determination to learn and succeed.

Originally posted on Himalayas

12423.description_html:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:
Join Walmart as a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable platform capabilities, including infrastructure, tooling, and AI/ML frameworks. This role drives the full software lifecycle, applying cloud-native architecture principles to enhance system resilience and agility. You will provide technical leadership, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate across functions to translate complex business needs into actionable solutions. Emphasizing innovation and engineering excellence, you will influence architectural decisions and continuously improve processes to support Walmart’s technology goals and deliver impactful results.


***Sponsorship is NOT available in this role***


About the team:
The Sponsored Search Ad Server team develops the core infrastructure powering Walmart Connect’s advertising platform. They build large-scale distributed systems delivering highly relevant ads with exceptional performance and reliability. Engineers collaborate closely with product, data science, machine learning, and infrastructure teams to address complex challenges in search, retrieval, ranking, and AI-driven advertising. This team leads the design of mission-critical services, drives cross-functional technical initiatives, mentors engineers, and shapes the future of Walmart’s advertising technology, ensuring scalable, resilient, and innovative solutions aligned with business goals.

What you'll do:
  • Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing systems using Java, Apache Spark, Kafka and Flink.
  • Strong background developing and managing data pipelines and cloud native solutions within GCP environments.
  • Familiarity with vector databases and modern data architectures that support AI/ML applications.
  • Drive full software development lifecycle activities such as coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
  • Apply cloud-native architecture principles to ensure scalable, resilient, and agile systems.
  • Conduct system design reviews to validate feasibility and ensure alignment with architectural best practices.
  • Build AI-driven applications and integrate ML components to enhance automation and intelligence.
  • Mentor engineers, influence technical decisions, and promote engineering excellence through continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate complex problems into actionable technical requirements.



What you'll bring:
  • Proven expertise in cloud-native architecture, including microservices, containers, and automation to ensure scalable and resilient systems.
  • Strong proficiency in software design patterns, API design, and platform development to deliver maintainable and modular solutions.
  • Experience leading full software development lifecycle activities, including coding, testing, CI/CD deployment, and observability.
  • Ability to analyze complex problems and apply data-driven decision-making to optimize engineering outcomes.
  • Skilled in mentoring and providing technical leadership to foster team growth and uphold engineering excellence.
  • Demonstrated adaptability to evolving technologies and collaborative cross-team communication skills.


At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.
Sunnyvale, California US-11657: The annual salary range for this position is $143,000.00 - $286,000.00
Bentonville, Arkansas US-10735: The annual salary range for this position is $110,000.00 - $220,000.00 Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance bonuses. Additional compensation for certain positions may also include :
- Stock

Option 2: 6 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.

12421.description_html:
Future Talent: Senior Software Engineer- Java (Talent Community – India)

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad 
Position Type: Future Opening – Talent Pipeline


LSEG Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial markets data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users across approximately 190 markets, we are an essential partner to the global financial community and redefining the future of data in financial services. We enable customers to draw crucial insights through data, feeds, analytics, AI and workflow solutions.

Our engineers design, develop and deliver the products and services that reimagine how our industry works. Driving innovation through digitalisation and AI, we deliver accelerated impact and excellence for customers every day.


The Opportunity


We are seeking passionate software engineers from mid-level to lead to help us build robust, enterprise-grade solutions that drive real-world impact.

Our problems are complex from building AI-powered analytics that are constantly evolving, to challenges that define modern finance, giving engineers the opportunity to stretch their craft and shape solutions that matter.

Our software engineers have a strong appetite for innovation, new technologies, and AI, both in how we accelerate engineering and in how we create smarter, more valuable experiences for our customers. We encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning, giving our teams the opportunity to solve complex challenges at scale.


What We Look For


We place great value on technical excellence and a drive for continuous learning.

  • 6+ years of experienced Software Engineers in Java development
  • Strong experience with CI/CD, unit testing framework and automation (testing/deployment) in cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
  • Curiosity about AI and a strong interest in how emerging technologies can be applied to solve complex software engineering problems.
  • Prior Financial Services or Big Tech experience preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering and related field or relevant experience
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • Willingness to learn and work with new technologies across the full stack
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate optimally with cross-functional teams across multiple regions and timezones

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

12420.description_html:
About AutoZone:

AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 6,000 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Brazil. Each store carries an extensive line of cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light trucks, including new and remanufactured hard parts, maintenance items, and accessories.

 

We also sell automotive diagnostic and repair software through ALLDATA, diagnostic and repair information through ALLDATAdiy.com, automotive accessories through AutoAnything.com, and auto and light truck parts and accessories through AutoZone.com.

 

Since opening its first store in Forrest City, Ark. on July 4, 1979, the company has joined the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AZO) and earned a spot in the Fortune 500.

 

AutoZone has been committed to providing the best parts, prices, and customer service in the automotive aftermarket industry. We have a rich culture and history of going the Extra Mile for our customers and our community. At AutoZone you’re not just doing a job; you’re playing a crucial role in creating a better experience for our customers while creating opportunities to DRIVE YOUR CAREER almost anywhere! We are looking for talented, customer-focused people, enjoy helping others, and have the DRIVE to excel in a fast-paced environment!

Position Summary

To deliver desired, sustainable business outcomes and assure the integrity and continuity of our systems. This position is responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of AutoZone’s hardware, software, and/or network applications. This includes acquiring domain knowledge, growing technical skills, supporting the customers, resolving problems, and training as required. Provide support to sustainable business outcomes and assure the integrity and continuity of our systems.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in any and potentially all roles of the systems support and monitoring. Roles may vary by project and assignment. This may include but is not limited to maintain software applications and/or subsystems; debug, design, code, test, write specifications, roll-out software, upgrade, and production support.

  • Support new features, scaling, automation and self-healing processes for sites and systems

  • Identify and implement configuration changes to improve performance and reliability as necessary.

  • Coordinate with product owners and business partners to address the Business problems and document them as needed. 

  • Update job knowledge by studying state-of-the-art development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment. Continuous learning of AutoZone Culture, Methodology, Architecture, and Software. (Own Professional Development) 

  • Identify and eliminate manual and/or inefficient processes through the implementation of innovative technology solutions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field required

  • Experience in the Retail Industry developing and maintaining applications is desired.

  • Requires 4 to 5 years of experience based on consistently demonstrated capabilities.

  • Utilizing UNIX, Linux, Windows, Oracle DB, PostgreSQL, DB2/SQL and APM tools to monitor and support the application.

  • Experience in JAVA, spring, RDBMS is preferred.

  • Knowledge of ATG framework and BCC is preferred.

  • Knowledge on GCP related technologies is preferred.

  • Experience with scripting (Shell, Python, Ansible etc.) and good understanding of Unix/Linux is preferred.

  • Experience with monitoring tools (Dynatrace, Splunk, ELK, APM, etc.) is preferred.

  • Solid problem solving, domain technical and analytical skills

  • Ability to perform tasks with little or no technical supervision.

About Us

AutoZone opened its first AutoZone do Brasil store in the city of Sorocaba in September 2012. Our customer-first mindset and commitment to Going the Extra Mile define who we are, for both our customers and AutoZoners. Working at AutoZone means being part of a team that values dedication, teamwork and growth. Whether you're helping customers or building your career, we provide tools and support to help you succeed and drive your future.


AutoZone, and its subsidiary, ALLDATA are equal opportunity employers. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other legally protected categories.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Senior Software Engineer – React.js / Next.js, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high-quality web applications. You will work closely with product managers, designers, QA engineers, backend engineers, and other cross-functional teams to build modern, responsive, and reliable digital experiences.

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and RESTful APIs.
  • Build responsive, accessible, reusable, and high-performance UI components using React.js, Next.js, and modern front-end development practices.
  • Develop and maintain front-end applications that integrate with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, third-party systems, and enterprise platforms.
  • Work extensively with Next.js concepts including server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), routing, API integration, and front-end performance optimization.
  • Implement state management and data-fetching solutions using technologies such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Context API, React Query/TanStack Query, or SWR.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers to define API contracts, integration patterns, error handling, and data flows.
  • Develop clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-tested code following modern front-end architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Ensure applications meet standards for performance, scalability, accessibility, usability, and security.
  • Conduct comprehensive code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to team members.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Work with DevOps and engineering teams to support CI/CD, cloud deployments, monitoring, release management, and production support.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture discussions and contribute to decisions related to front-end architecture and application scalability.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with emerging React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web development technologies and practices.

Qualifications

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of hands-on software development experience, with significant experience building enterprise-level web applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React.js and modern React development practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and modern application development patterns.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, and modern browser technologies.
  • Hands-on experience developing reusable and scalable React components and front-end architectures.
  • Strong understanding of Next.js concepts including SSR, SSG, routing, API integration, rendering strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with React state management and data-fetching libraries such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Context API, React Query/TanStack Query, or SWR.
  • Experience integrating front-end applications with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of REST API integration, asynchronous programming, error handling, authentication, and authorization.
  • Experience with modern UI frameworks, styling systems, or component libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Chakra UI, Styled Components, Emotion, Shadcn/UI, or Radix UI.
  • Experience with modern front-end build tools and package managers such as Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, Yarn, or pnpm.
  • Experience with Git and source control, Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.
  • Hands-on experience with front-end testing and automation frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Understanding of web application security, including authentication/authorization patterns, OAuth2, JWT, secure coding practices, and common web vulnerabilities.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerized application environments.
  • Knowledge of application monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting applications in production environments, including incident troubleshooting and resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with incident management processes and tools such as ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Healthcare domain experience, including familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, HIPAA, PHI, or healthcare applications.
  • Experience with other modern front-end frameworks such as Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Angular, Svelte, SvelteKit, Remix, or Gatsby.
  • Experience building and maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Experience with micro-frontends or large-scale front-end architectures.
  • Experience with GraphQL, API Gateways, gRPC, or event-driven integrations.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, and web application architecture.
  • Experience with web performance optimization, including Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, caching, and bundle optimization.
  • Experience with accessibility standards, including WCAG and accessible UI development.
  • Experience working with message-driven architectures such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or AWS SNS.
  • Experience contributing to technical architecture and design decisions for enterprise applications.
  • Experience mentoring developers and providing technical leadership within an engineering team.

 

Core Technologies

React.js | Next.js | TypeScript | JavaScript | HTML5 | CSS3 | REST APIs | GraphQL | Redux / Redux Toolkit | React Query / TanStack Query | Git | CI/CD | Cloud | Docker

Additional Information

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.
Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.
Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 
Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.
Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

12416.description_html:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
  • Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud
  • A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created
  • A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone
  • The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it
  • Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it
  • A preference for being corrected over being right
  • Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Think you’re a good fit for this job? 

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them! 

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

12406.description_html:
Are you looking for an opportunity to help solve one of today's biggest business challenges? AI is changing the pace of business, and organizations everywhere are struggling to help their workforce, partners, and customers keep up. At Litmos, we're building the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build human capability faster—and we're looking for people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact for customers while growing alongside a collaborative, people-first team.

Litmos is the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build capability faster, adapt at the speed business changes, and scale learning to anyone, anywhere. Combining an intuitive platform, AI-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning.

Organizations such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Graco, Sabre, and Russell Mineral Equipment trust Litmos to accelerate learning across their workforce, partners, and customers. Today, more than 11K customers with 30 million learners across 150 countries and 37 languages use Litmos to build the capabilities their organizations need to succeed. Backed by Francisco Partners, one of the world's leading technology investment firms, we're investing in the future of learning—and the people who are building it. Learn more at www.litmos.com.


We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build and evolve our platform using .NET, React, and SQL Server-based systems. You will work across services, APIs, and front-end systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 

You will operate within a globally distributed Agile team (Scrum and ShapeUp), where engineers own delivery, from design through deployment, while collaborating closely with Product and Technical Ownership. 

Objectives of this Role 

  • Evaluate the existing platform and identify opportunities for service decomposition and modularization 
  • Design and implement microservices, APIs, and front-end components

12404.description_html:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 

You will join a collaborative engineering team specialized in developing cloud-native applications and integration solutions with the help of AI. The group combines technical expertise with functional knowledge of Finance & Procurement to deliver enterprise-grade solutions. 

 

As part of this team, you will lead the design and development of services in a continuous delivery model on the Nike cloud platform. This role will also partner with leads, architects and product managers, to help establish a technical vision and deliver innovative services which are consistent, robust, maintainable, and highly scalable. We follow agile methodologies and practice DevOps. You will regularly interact with P2P capability team, collaborate with other engineering teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers to ensure solutions meet global expectations for financial service, security, reliability, and performance.  

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a passion for building and maintaining data platforms and delivering next-generation procurement and invoice technology solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, have a proven track record of delivering reliable software at scale, and are excited to drive engineering excellence and team capability. This role will elevate the technical aptitude of the team through mentorship, pairing, code reviews, architectural guidance, and design discussions. A learning mindset, excellent analytical skills, and strong written and verbal communication are essential.  

 

Skillset Required 

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, with a strong foundation in distributed microservice architecture, Domain-Driven Design and RESTful services 
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Node.js, Java 
  • Proven ability to deliver high-impact, API-first microservices at scale 
  • Deep expertise with cloud platforms like AWS offerings (e.g., SQS, DynamoDB, S3, SNS, CloudWatch, EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS) 
  • Experience designing and optimizing data pipelines using Apache Spark or Databricks 
  • Proficiency in containerized application development, deployment, and orchestration 
  • Demonstrated expertise in Terraform, CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code operations 
  • Experience leading technical design discussions and making critical architecture decisions 
  • Experience with monitoring and tracing tools like Splunk, SignalFx 
  • Familiarity with GitHub, JIRA, Jenkins 
  • Hands-on development experience with tools like VS Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot  
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills 
  • Proven track record in working with fast-paced, results-oriented environment which has globally distributed and diverse teams 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to effectively communicate with both Product and Technical teams 
  • Integration experience with SaaS platforms (e.g., Coupa, Ariba), SAP, and middleware solutions (Oracle Fusion) is a plus 
  • Working experience integrating with open-source applications (e.g., Kafka, NiFi) is a plus 
  • Knowledge of AI & ML concepts and applications is a plus 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON 

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data platforms and services supporting complex transactional flows globally 
  • Architect SDKs, APIs, and microservices to support enterprise-wide data and analytics needs 
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with all needed documentation 
  • Drive best practices in software development, data governance, and platform observability 
  • Make critical technical design choices and establish architectural patterns across the team 
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to develop robust solutions 
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through testing and validation 
  • Develop artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions tailored to specific use cases 
  • Provide mentorship and help develop technical talent in alignment with Nike's technology standards 
  • Lead code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues 
  • Follow Agile methodologies and practice DevOps

12403.description_html:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You will be a part of the larger Global Technology organization working on Nike’s internal product creation tools and report to the team’s Engineering Manager.  You will work day-to-day with the a team of engineers, the team’s Product Manager and Principal Engineers in the organization on software projects to achieve Nike’s business objectives.  You will also engage with other Global Technology functions and teams on organizational and technical goals.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to solve complex software engineering problems supporting Nike’s pursuit of delivering state of the art tools to our product developers and broader creation community. The candidate needs to be highly collaborative with peers, productive in a fast-paced development environment and have depth of native cloud software engineering experience.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You will be part of a team of engineers building out tooling for our internal Innovation & Consumer Creation team members. We are investing in building modular, configurable and “API-First” capabilities which will be consumed by modern web applications build with the most recent SPA frameworks. 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, Information Systems, or similar field or relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree

  • 5+ years of hands-on industry software development experience.

  • Demonstrated expertise in node.js,   python or similar languages

  • Experience with cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and related tools.

  • Experience with AWS products including Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, s3

  • Modern testing methodologies and frameworks such as Mocha, Jasmine and Jest

  • Strong understanding of architectural design patterns and computer-science fundamentals

  • Experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, Javascript

  • HTML + HTML5, including Flexbox, semantic markup, accessibility and concepts such as OOCSS, BEM and ATOMIC)

  • Experience with implementing and integrating AI, Machine Learning and related data solutions preferred.

  • Experience with browser APIs, including a working knowledge of event lifecycles and performance optimization

  • CSS + CSS2, including cross-browser compliance

  • 2+ years of hands on experience with technologies such as vue.js, vuetify.js, vuext, React (experience with other frameworks such as Angular is a plus), Redux, Template Technologies, Micro Services, REST Web Services.

We are looking Software Engineers with 5+ years of experience and a passion for building scalable, cloud-native software solutions. In this role, you will own, design, develop, and enhance cutting-edge applications in the observability domain, leveraging modern technologies, automation frameworks, and cloud-native platforms. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and high-performance solutions while driving engineering excellence in a dynamic and agile environment.
 

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and enhance scalable cloud-native software solutions and observability platform capabilities using modern architectures, technologies, and engineering best practices.
  • Own end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements analysis and technical design to implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance issues, conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents, and drive improvements in application reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, containerized deployments, and Kubernetes-based solutions to improve engineering efficiency and product quality.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools and engineering productivity solutions to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality, and enhance developer effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with architects, area product owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions while driving technical excellence in Agile/Scrum environments.
Qualifications

You have:

  • Engineering Degree with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering cloud-native, distributed software systems using Golang and microservices-based architectures.
  • Hands-on experience building cloud-native microservices and distributed systems using Kubernetes and containerization technologies.
  • Proficiency in designing and developing scalable backend services, REST/gRPC APIs, and event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging platforms.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring technologies, including telemetry collection, metrics, logging, tracing, and troubleshooting large-scale systems, will certainly be an advantage.
  • Good understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and automation practices using tools such as Jenkins, GitOps, Helm, and container-based deployment pipelines.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with strong collaboration, technical ownership, and problem-solving skills; exposure to AI-assisted development tools is a plus.
  •  Full Stack development experience using ReatJS will be an advantage.

12187.description_html:
We’re hiring a kickass Growth Engineer for a world-renowned Growth Consulting company based out of Spain. If you love Frontend Technologies and share an equal love for Marketing and growth, Read on!

The team you work with uses technology with purpose, reason, and logic. They don't jump on every new bandwagon or complicate things unnecessarily. They start with the basics and are keen to explore the cutting-edge.

In other words, they’re proficient in React, TypeScript, or Svelte, but work extensively on HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Do you want to be the next astronaut at the fastest-growing Growth Platform team in Europe and take your career to new heights?

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You'll join a platform team that empowers our Service Squads with experimentation capabilities. As one of the Growth Engineers, you'll be a developer with Frontend chops, crafting experiments and the tools to build them. We're scouting for someone with ideally over 4 years of Frontend development experience. The more, the merrier, as it means more time to hone your problem-solving skills.

WHAT'S YOUR TICKET TO SUCCESS WITH US?

  • We're searching for a Frontend developer with 4 years of experience (preferably), who thrives in an agile environment and isn't fazed by any framework or tool. Degrees and diplomas take a back seat to hard work and tangible results.
  • Working directly with the DOM, we value a deep understanding of its construction and operation, including the rendering process in browsers. A strong foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is crucial as they are the bedrock of our work. Keeping abreast of their trends and frameworks is the icing on the cake.
  • Web performance and Core Web Vitals are pivotal in our daily operations, so an understanding of a website's loading process and how to speed it up is crucial. Knowing how Google evaluates this aspect is also important.
  • Teamwork experience with Git is essential. Being methodical and adhering to a common naming convention and process is key.
  • Enjoying teamwork, and being unafraid to seek or offer help when needed is crucial. We operate as a single unit, celebrating successes and learning from mistakes together.
  • Managing criticism well, both giving and receiving, is important. We value best practices, continuous improvement, and open, heartfelt communication.
  • Most importantly, you should be eager to learn and share your knowledge with others.
  • All the above is essential, as it enables us to work the way we do. We know we demand a lot, but we aim high and need people aligned with our goals.

High-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, or Svelte, and extensive experience on HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

ALSO, IT WOULD BE IDEAL IF YOU

  • Have experience working with Svelte
  • Have experience with CDNs and cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure), which would greatly enhance the team's expertise.
  • Have dabbled in Growth or Digital Marketing, which is a plus, but not a deal-breaker.
  • Are familiar with web analytics tools like Google Analytics or Amplitude, or experimentation tools like Google Tag Manager, Optimize, or VWO. If not, you'll learn them here as we use them daily.

At Markeeters, our Mission is to connect the Top 1% of Technology, Growth & Marketing Experts from India to Global Businesses.

We're building the future of work for India's top remote talent.

Originally posted on Himalayas

12136.description_html:
Job Description:

Role Title: AVP, Web Engineer III (L10)


Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.


Organization Overview

Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.

Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.


Role Summary/Purpose:

This role will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform using Java, Spring boot and Node.js, and will leverage working knowledge of platforms such as PCF and AWS. The individual will set engineering standards, perform code reviews, mentor developers, and partner with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Lead and mentor a team of developers, fostering a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Perform regular code reviews to ensure code quality, security, maintainability, and alignment with architecture and engineering standards.
  • Provide hands-on development across the stack using Java Spring boot framework and Node.js (for backend), ReactJs (for frontend) including building APIs, Micro-services, and UI components.
  • Drive technical design discussions and guide implementation decisions (system design, integration patterns, performance, scalability, and reliability).
  • Oversee delivery execution for the team: plan work, manage priorities, remove blockers, and ensure timely completion of commitments.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with APIs, webhooks, authentication, and partner onboarding workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, UX, QA, and Operations across the SDLC—from requirements through release and post-production support.
  • Support production readiness and operational excellence: troubleshoot issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
  • Promote and improve engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, coding standards, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate effectively with geographically distributed teams and ensure consistent implementation of shared standards and processes.

Qualifications/Requirements:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 4+ years in software engineering and 2+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role.
  • 4+ years of expertise in Java, Spring boot, Node JS and React JS, with proven ability to lead design and implementation for complex web applications.
  • Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event-driven systems), and building mission-critical services with high availability and performance.
  • Experience with Micro-Frontends (preferred) and front-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost-aware design.
  • Familiarity with Apigee or a similar API management platform is preferred but not required.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
  • AI-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to work flexible shifts/on-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.

Desired Skills/ Knowledge:

  • Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to work flexible shifts/on-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.

Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

For Internal Applicants:

  • Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
  • Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
  • Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
  • Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
  • L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
  • L08+ Employees can apply

Level / Grade : 10

Job Family Group:

Information Technology

# Senior / Staff Backend Software Engineer (.NET, AI-Assisted Development)

## Why This Opportunity

Join a fast-growing SaaS company modernizing how professional services firms manage billing, payments, collections, and revenue operations.

You'll work on complex backend systems that process business-critical financial workflows while helping shape an engineering culture that embraces AI-assisted development without compromising software quality. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys owning technical decisions, solving distributed systems challenges, and using modern AI tools to accelerate delivery responsibly.

## About the Company

We're a SaaS company building an intelligent revenue operations platform for professional services organizations. Our platform streamlines billing, collections, payments, forecasting, and financial workflows through automation, AI-powered insights, and secure cloud infrastructure.

Our engineering team values thoughtful architecture, rapid iteration, and high engineering standards, combining AI-assisted development with disciplined software engineering practices.

## Why This Role Matters

You'll help build the core backend systems that power mission-critical financial workflows.

Beyond writing code, you'll own technical solutions from initial problem definition through production deployment. You'll help define architectural direction, establish engineering best practices, and demonstrate how AI-assisted development can increase engineering velocity while maintaining reliability, security, and maintainability.

## What You'll Build

- Design and develop scalable backend services using C# and .NET.
- Own features from technical discovery through architecture, implementation, testing, and production deployment.
- Build secure APIs, distributed services, and cloud-native applications.
- Design data models and integration patterns for complex business workflows.
- Develop proof-of-concepts to evaluate technical approaches before production implementation.
- Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation while maintaining engineering quality.
- Establish appropriate context, testing strategies, and guardrails for AI-generated code.
- Review code for correctness, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
- Build automated testing, observability, and validation into the software delivery lifecycle.
- Mentor fellow engineers through architecture discussions, technical reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.
- Identify opportunities to build reusable engineering components, internal tooling, automation, and AI-powered developer workflows.

## Who We're Looking For

### Must Have

- **7+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with a strong focus on building production backend systems using **C# and .NET / .NET Core**.
- Proven experience designing and delivering scalable distributed systems, REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and cloud-native applications.
- Strong system design and software architecture skills, with experience owning technical decisions from design through production deployment.
- Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably **Azure**), CI/CD pipelines, containers, and modern software delivery practices.
- Strong understanding of relational databases, backend application architecture, and production engineering best practices.
- Experience using **AI-assisted development tools** such as **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot**, or similar platforms as part of day-to-day engineering workflows.
- Ability to critically review AI-generated code, identifying architectural, security, testing, and quality concerns before production.
- Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical problem-solving skills.
- Experience building automated tests and maintaining high standards for software quality and reliability.
- Comfortable mentoring other engineers through technical reviews and architecture discussions.
- Based in **India** with availability to collaborate closely with the engineering team.

### Nice to Have

- Experience building frontend applications with **React** and **TypeScript**.
- Experience within **enterprise SaaS**, **fintech**, **legal technology**, **billing**, or **payments** platforms.
- Exposure to AI technologies such as:
  - AI agents
  - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  - Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  - LLM-powered applications
- Experience building internal engineering platforms, reusable tooling, or developer automation.
- Familiarity with security and compliance standards such as **SOC 2** or **ISO 27001**.

- **C#**
- **.NET / .NET Core**

- Distributed systems
- Asynchronous processing

### Cloud & DevOps

- Azure

12158.description_html:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona
URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

  • Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles
  • Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering
  • Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management
  • Job and project tracking
  • Client and vendor dashboards
  • Online payments and transaction tracking
  • Reviews and ratings
  • Notifications and communications
  • Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities
  • Admin tools for managing the platform
  • Reporting and analytics
  • Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Full-stack web development
  • Mobile or cross-platform app development
  • Strong front-end and back-end development
  • Multi-user marketplace platforms
  • User authentication and account management
  • Payment gateway integrations
  • Databases and APIs
  • Third-party integrations
  • Dashboards and reporting
  • Secure, scalable application architecture
  • Cloud hosting and deployment
  • Testing, maintenance, and optimization
  • Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace, we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

Interested? Tell Us About Yourself

Please send us:

  • A quick introduction
  • Your resume or LinkedIn profile
  • Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built
  • Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on
  • What you personally worked on for those projects
  • Your experience using AI in development
  • What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why
  • Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

12039.description_html:
Role : Software Engineer - Open Source Contributions

Job Description :


Experts will participate in an impactful customer project focused on high-quality, open source software development. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work :

- Develop, implement, and refine new features within existing open source codebases using Python3, Java, Rust, C++, and Typescript.

- Analyze and resolve complex bugs, ensuring robust and maintainable solutions that align with project standards.

- Refactor and optimize legacy code to enhance performance, readability, and scalability.

- Contribute to code validation processes, focusing on accuracy, output consistency, and best coding practices.

- Utilize advanced algorithms and competitive programming techniques to conceptualize and deliver efficient solutions for intricate problems.

- Collaborate remotely with other contributors to review proposed changes and maintain project documentation.

- Deliver clear, concise technical write-ups to articulate solution design and implementation details.

Preferred Qualifications :

- Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following : Python, C++, Java, Rust, Typescript, Go, or C#.

- Extensive experience in open source contributions, particularly in feature development, bug fixing, and codebase refactoring.

- Demonstrated expertise in competitive programming and complex coding problem analysis.

- Strong analytical skills to interpret multifaceted problem constraints and identify multiple solution pathways.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for clear, precise technical documentation and peer collaboration.

- Meticulous attention to detail in code review, validation, and maintenance.

- Comfort working independently in a remote, collaborative environment with a commitment to producing high-quality, well-documented code under project deadlines.

Compensation Structure :

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert's experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Aptlogica Technologies is a Pune-based technology company delivering AI/ML, Generative and Agentic AI, product engineering and cloud solutions for enterprise clients, alongside its own learning-technology products.

About the role:

Build applications that connect enterprise data with large language models, developing complete retrieval-augmented generation pipelines from document ingestion and embeddings to vector retrieval, model integration and API deployment.

- Build AI applications with Python, FastAPI, LangChain and LangGraph

- Develop document ingestion, preprocessing, embedding and vector-indexing pipelines

- Build semantic and vector search workflows

- Improve retrieval quality and LLM response accuracy

- Integrate LLMs with databases, APIs and enterprise applications

- Develop scalable REST APIs for AI capabilities

- Diagnose and improve RAG and LLM application performance

- 3 - 7 years of overall professional experience, including 1 - 3 years of directly relevant hands-on experience

- Strong Python development skills and experience building REST APIs with FastAPI

- Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph and RAG architecture

- Experience with PGVector, Pinecone, FAISS or another vector database

- Experience integrating OpenAI, Gemini or Claude models

- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL

- Proficiency with Docker, Git and collaborative development workflows

- Experience deploying AI applications in cloud environments

- Experience with RAG evaluation frameworks

- Knowledge of hybrid search and reranking

- Experience processing enterprise documents

One interview round with Aptlogica, followed by one or two client interview rounds.

3 positions | Location: PAN India (remote)

Role : AI Engineer (LLM / GenAI)

Location : Bengaluru / Remote-First (India). We can start remote for now, but since we work in a consulting model they will have to travel to the client location and work from there as per business needs.

Full-Time | Founding Team

Competitive Salary (Fixed + Variable + ESOPs)

Experience : 2 - 5 years

NP : Immediate joiners only

Client is building the next generation of enterprise-grade AI products and platforms. We partner with large enterprises and fast-growing startups to architect, build, and deploy production-ready AI systems that create measurable business impact.

We're an early-stage, high-caliber team of AI builders, architects, and operators. This is a unique opportunity to join the founding engineering team and help shape both our technology and engineering culture from the ground up.

What You'll Do :

- Build end-to-end AI applications powered by LLMs and Generative AI

- Develop and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines

- Implement embedding, retrieval, prompting, response processing, and evaluation workflows

- Integrate leading LLM providers and build orchestration layers for AI systems

- Create scalable APIs and services exposing AI capabilities

- Design evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, latency, cost, and safety

- Collaborate closely with GenAI Architects to convert AI designs into production-ready solutions

- Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code

- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices

What We're Looking For :

Required :

- 2 - 7 years of software engineering experience

- Strong Python programming skills

- Experience working with LLMs, Generative AI, or ML systems in production

- Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks

- Strong understanding of vector databases and semantic search

- Experience building REST APIs and scalable backend services

- Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure cloud environments

- Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and system design skills

Nice to Have :

- Fine-tuning experience (LoRA, QLoRA)

- Experience with Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch

- Familiarity with LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, or LLM observability tools

- Exposure to Agentic AI and multi-agent systems

- Background in Data Engineering or ML Engineering

Why Join? :

- Build real-world enterprise AI products from Day One

- Work alongside experienced GenAI Architects and AI leaders

- Structured career growth from L2 to L5

- ESOP participation and long-term wealth creation

- Remote-first culture with flexibility and ownership

- Opportunity to define engineering standards in a fast-growing AI company

Educational Qualification :

B.E./B.Tech, M.Tech, or M.S. from Tier-1 institutes or reputed regional engineering colleges such as PES University, RVCE, BMSCE, MSRIT, and similar institutions.

Tech Stack :

- Python | LangChain | LlamaIndex | OpenAI | Anthropic | RAG | Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) | AWS | GCP | Azure | Hugging Face | PyTorch | Agentic AI

If you're excited about building production-grade AI systems rather than demos and want to work at the frontier of Generative AI, we'd love to hear from you.
